Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.
A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
Meal vouchers.
Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.
Be part of an experienced and international team.
A good vibe working environment.
The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.
Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.
The freedom to innovate, experiment, and help shape smarter ways of working.

Title: Sr Business Analyst
Description:
Senior Business Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience working with consumer, CRM, loyalty, or customer lifecycle data.
Understanding of consumer behavior from acquisition to retention.
Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world.  Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organisation which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving our strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to hire a Marketing Data Analyst to strengthen our MCBD function.

The Opportunity

This role is within the evolving global business development team. You will be working with business development personnel across the firm, including those responsible for the development of client systems and those running business development programmes such as the client programme, the contractor programme and initiatives identified by the Business and Markets Executive / Business Growth and Client Systems leadership. The winning of work and associated activities are key to the success of Arup, more than ever before. This is an opportunity to be part of the team enabling firm growth.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and assist in the development of all forms of Power BI reporting utilizing CRM, finance and other data for use by the marketing, communications, business development and Business and Markets communities across Arup.
Work with leadership, MCBD and other members of the Client Systems team to define requirements for reporting, to sketch out possible solutions, and to elicit feedback once reporting has been created.
Support the coordination of the Marketing Data Warehouse. Work with our digital marketing experts on our data warehouse that stores data from our digital marketing platform, Marketo, and its evolution to encompass website and social media data. Its aim is to give a complete picture of the operation of our digital marketing channels.
Bring your expertise in reporting to support the development of CRM and other tools so that our data is best configured to produce the reporting we need.
Explore the use of AI to support development of reporting solutions as well as generate insights into our business growth department.
Collaborate with the wider ARUP’s analytics community in predictive modeling and statistical analysis projects that would help surface insights around improving our work-winning processes.


Is this role right for me?

Requirements


Experience in the use of Power BI plus high-level Excel skills.  Desire to grow these skills. Potential interest in languages such as Python and tools such as Databricks and SQL querying.
Experience working with CRM and/or finance data. Knowledge of how to clean data prior to processing.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to think laterally to suggest potential solutions.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.


Qualifications And Accreditations


Degree, postgraduate qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Knowledge Management or a related field.


Knowledge And Experience


Experience in data management, knowledge management and analytics.
Knowledge of client systems and software development.
Proficiency in marketing and communications related technologies, and knowledge of marketing data including bidding and clients data.
Experience in building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of current trends in AI, data information, machine learning and data quality is a plus.


Skills And Attributes


Skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.
Communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Able to build collaborative and inclusive working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.
High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership.
Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organisation’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honourable dealings.


What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit: https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies – We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The PT Digital & Operational Excellence (PTE) organization works in partnership across major global business functions, establishing and implementing an overall Digital / Technology strategy. Our goal is to drive the delivery and scale of key data and digital solutions in support of Roche’s vision.

The Role

As a Data Analyst, you will be the critical link between complex business challenges, data consumers, and technical data solutions. In this role, you will not only profile and analyze data but will also act as the operational engine for our data product suite. You will own the visual management of data product performance, and manage the end-to-end maintenance and support lifecycle. By ensuring data products are highly visible, measurable, and reliably supported, you enable diverse consumers—including Data Scientists, BI Experts, Senior Leaders, and automated applications—to unlock maximum value from our data assets.

Working within a multidisciplinary team alongside Data Domain Leads, Data Product Owners, SMEs, and Data Engineers, you will ensure our data products remain high-performing, well-maintained, and aligned with global governance standards.

Key Responsibilities


Data Profiling & Requirements Translation: Utilize SQL and Python to extract, profile, and analyze source data to support feature development and data cleansing initiatives. Translate complex business rules into technical analytical specifications for the engineering team
Integrity, Compliance & Quality: Ensure all data products meet rigorous data integrity, security, and validation standards. Collaborate with the Validation Lead and Tester to define acceptance criteria and design test layouts
Data Exploration & Discovery: Conduct deep-dive data exploration and review prospective data sources during data product development in close collaboration with the Data Domain Lead (DDL) to assess viability, identify data quality constraints, and uncover hidden value
Collaborative Data Modeling: Contribute actively to conceptual and logical data modeling efforts, partnering closely with the Data Product Owner (DPO) and the architectural team to design schemas that support diverse downstream user needs
Standardization, Contracts & Lifecycle Documentation: Contribute to data standardization initiatives to ensure portfolio scalability. Define, implement, and maintain formal data contracts alongside up-to-date data dictionaries and metadata layers so consumers understand exactly what data is available, its expected schema, and how to safely use it
Performance & Visual Management: Design, build, and maintain data product monitoring dashboards (e.g., using Tableau or PowerBI). Track and visually report on Data Quality KPIs, product adoption metrics, system latency, and user satisfaction to provide transparency to senior leadership and consumers
Maintenance & Support Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for data product operational support. Lead incident management efforts, conduct root-cause analysis for anomalies or pipeline failures, evaluate business impact, and coordinate with Data Engineers to deploy hotfixes and changes


Who You Are


Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Biotechnology, or a related field
Pharma & Quality Expert: You possess 5+ years of experience in Pharma Technical Operations and have a proven track record in project-based work within the pharmaceutical industry, including knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, FDA) and Quality systems
Analytical & Visual Architect: Highly proficient in data visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI) and intermediate to advanced SQL / Python for data extraction and transformation. Ability to relate complex data sets to logical structures
Systems Fluency: Familiarity with business-facing systems such as SAP, SAC, ELN, LIMS, MES, or LES is a major plus
Operations & Agile Mindset: Experienced in handling application support, incident management, and change control. Fluent in Agile delivery methodologies and tools like Jira or HP ALM
Strong Communicator: Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills (fluent English), with the ability to present complex data product performance metrics clearly to senior executives and technical consumers alike


Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Title: Workday Reporting Data Analyst - Full remote Spain or Portugal
Description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Workday Reporting Data Analyst - Full remote Spain or Portugal

We’re looking for a Workday Reporting Data Analyst to transform HR data into reliable reporting, meaningful metrics, and actionable insights. This role is central to maintaining data integrity, improving reporting quality, and helping Colleague Resources teams make informed decisions across global operations.

You’ll design and maintain Workday reports, analyse complex HR datasets, support system administration and releases, and translate business needs into practical reporting solutions. Working with international HRIS, Colleague Resources, IT, and business stakeholders, you’ll combine technical expertise with a strong understanding of HR processes.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Workday reports ranging from simple operational reports to matrix, trended, and composite reports.
Deliver meaningful HR metrics, trends, dashboards, charts, and analytical insights to support Colleague Resources operations and decision-making.
Translate business requirements into clear, scalable, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, data discrepancies, improvement opportunities, and areas for partnership with internal stakeholders.
Support HRIS administration through group data updates, imports, exports, data clean-up, and investigation of data quality issues.
Contribute to Workday releases, upgrades, implementations, and functional testing, ensuring reporting continuity and process quality.
Act as a liaison between HRIS and functional teams, combining system knowledge with an understanding of HR processes and business priorities.
Coordinate reporting guidance and training, and respond to stakeholder questions in a clear and practical way.
Engage with the Workday Community, monitor relevant developments, and share useful insights with Colleague Resources leadership.
Ensure reporting and data-handling activities align with security, privacy, and data governance standards.


The skills you will have when you apply


Strong Workday reporting experience – hands-on experience creating and maintaining custom reports, including matrix, trended, and composite reports, using Workday Report Writer and standard reporting functionality.
Data analytics capability – experience analysing complex datasets, identifying trends and discrepancies, and presenting meaningful metrics and insights; knowledge of data mining, operational analytics, data models, and SQL is preferred.
HRIS and systems understanding – strong knowledge of Workday administration, data integrity, reporting processes, and HR systems, with the ability to support testing, releases, and process improvements.
Advanced Microsoft tools – strong Excel capability, including formulas and macros, together with proficiency in PowerPoint and Visio.
Business analysis and problem-solving – able to translate requirements into functional solutions, investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend sustainable improvements.
Clear communication and stakeholder partnership – able to explain data and technical topics in a simple, practical way, deliver presentations, coordinate training, and build effective relationships with HRIS, HR, IT, and business teams.
International collaboration and adaptability – comfortable working in a global, fast-moving environment, managing priorities, adapting to change, and contributing effectively within a team.


Experience and education


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Five years of related experience, including three years working with database migration and/or integration and large-scale, complex datasets, with a focus on reporting and analytics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in business operations or human resources is preferred, together with Workday administration, custom reporting, and troubleshooting experience.
A basic understanding of ServiceNow and case management is an advantage.


Working context


This role is fully remote and based in Spain or Portugal.
You will collaborate with international HRIS, Colleague Resources, IT, and business teams across countries and time zones.
You will help strengthen reporting standards, data quality, and the use of HR analytics to support better business decisions.

Sedgwick is the world’s leading risk and claims administration partner, helping clients thrive by navigating the unexpected. The company’s expertise, combined with advanced AI-enabled technology, supports solutions in claims administration, loss adjusting, benefits administration, and product recall.

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. Our colleagues support people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

  • Design, build, and maintain Workday reports ranging from simple operational reports to matrix, trended, and composite reports.
  • Deliver meaningful HR metrics, trends, dashboards, charts, and analytical insights to support Colleague Resources operations and decision-making.
  • Translate business requirements into clear, scalable, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
  • Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, data discrepancies, improvement opportunities, and areas for partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Support HRIS administration through group data updates, imports, exports, data clean-up, and investigation of data quality issues.

The skills you will have when you apply

  • Strong Workday reporting experience – hands-on experience creating and maintaining custom reports, including matrix, trended, and composite reports, using Workday Report Writer and standard reporting functionality.

  • Advanced Microsoft tools – strong Excel capability, including formulas and macros, together with proficiency in PowerPoint and Visio.
  • Business analysis and problem-solving – able to translate requirements into functional solutions, investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend sustainable improvements.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder partnership – able to explain data and technical topics in a simple, practical way, deliver presentations, coordinate training, and build effective relationships with HRIS, HR, IT, and business teams.
  • International collaboration and adaptability – comfortable working in a global, fast-moving environment, managing priorities, adapting to change, and contributing effectively within a team.

Experience and education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is preferred.
  • Five years of related experience, including three years working with database migration and/or integration and large-scale, complex datasets, with a focus on reporting and analytics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience in business operations or human resources is preferred, together with Workday administration, custom reporting, and troubleshooting experience.
  • A basic understanding of ServiceNow and case management is an advantage.

Working context

  • This role is fully remote and based in Spain or Portugal.
  • You will collaborate with international HRIS, Colleague Resources, IT, and business teams across countries and time zones.
  • You will help strengthen reporting standards, data quality, and the use of HR analytics to support better business decisions.

About Sedgwick

Sedgwick is the world’s leading risk and claims administration partner, helping clients thrive by navigating the unexpected. The company’s expertise, combined with advanced AI-enabled technology, supports solutions in claims administration, loss adjusting, benefits administration, and product recall.

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. Our colleagues support people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Ability to effectively collaborate with EMEA Insights & Analytics. Strong partnership skills with commercial organizations across business units.
Strong understanding of market dynamics and business challenges with a customer-oriented mindset.
Strategic perspective combined with attention to detail.
Proactive approach, solution orientation, and continuous improvement mindset.
Excellent analytical capabilities.
Strong adaptability and prioritization skills.
Project management capabilities.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication and leadership skills.
Ability to collaborate successfully in cross-functional environments.
Fluent English required.
Willingness to challenge the status quo and drive innovation.

Analytics, Business Controlling, Business Intelligence Management, Sales Force Effectiveness

Analytical Reasoning, Business Development, Business Valuations, Collaboration, Communication, Customer Centricity, Efficiency Analysis, Innovation, Operational Excellence, Problem Solving, Process Optimization, Relationship Building, Sales, Sales Enablement, Sales Support, Solutions Selling

Title: Senior Data Analyst Growth
Description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet the Team

The Marketing & Growth team is one of the largest and most dynamic at Fever, playing a central role in driving visibility, engagement, and business impact across the company. We work closely with nearly every department, combining strategy, creativity, and data to connect millions of people with unforgettable experiences.

Join us if you want to drive global impact, master data-driven creativity, and help millions of people discover their next unforgettable experience.

The Role

We're looking for a Growth Analytics Sr analyst to become the analytical backbone of Secret Media Network. You'll own the data infrastructure that the wider team relies on, and you'll use that data to actively find ways to grow the business. This is a hands-on role that mixes data engineering with genuine business analysis, and increasingly, AI-powered automation. You won't just report numbers, you'll help shape decisions with them and build the tools that make that analysis faster.

What You'll Do

Data Infrastructure & Reporting


Own and maintain the data pipelines and dashboards that power the team's reporting.
Ensure a single, consistent definition of core metrics across the team, so everyone measures success the same way.


Business Analytics & Experimentation


Design and run experiments to identify what drives better performance - from content formats to on-site features - and turn results into clear recommendations.
Proactively dig into the data to surface growth opportunities the team isn't yet acting on, not just answer questions you're asked.
Translate analysis into business impact


Data Foundations & Governance


Design the data and definitions that the whole team builds on. Not just fixing issues as they appear, but architecting the pipelines so those issues don't happen in the first place.
Set and enforce standards for data quality, documentation, and access, so the team can trust and self-serve the data with confidence.


AI & Automation


Use AI tools to speed up and scale analysis. From automating recurring reports to building AI-assisted workflows that surface insights without manual digging.
Identify opportunities to automate manual data/reporting processes, partnering with the team's automation and tooling function where needed.
Stay current on AI-powered analytics tooling and bring in what's genuinely useful


Cross-Functional Support


Act as the go-to data partner for the different functions across the team, translating their questions into reliable, fast answers.
Present findings in a way that non-technical stakeholders can act on, not just technical ones.


Who You Are


You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or another STEM field.
3-5 years of experience in a Data Analyst / Analytics / Business Intelligence role, ideally in a fast-paced, digital-first environment.
SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern data stacks (dbt or equivalent, cloud data warehouses).
Experience building and maintaining dashboards (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or similar).
Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate or accelerate analytics work
A genuinely curious, business-minded analyst — someone who enjoys asking "why" and "what should we do about it," not just "what happened."
Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests / experiments is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning messy questions into clear analysis.
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is a must; Spanish is a plus.


Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

Title: GTM Data Analyst
Description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:


Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Be the first dedicated analyst behind n8n's go-to-market motion.

Our commercial motion has two engines running at once: a self-serve product that thousands of developers adopt on their own, and an enterprise sales team closing the accounts that grow out of it. We've moved to usage-based pricing, migrated to Salesforce, and built a serious data foundation. What we don't have yet is someone whose entire job is making sense of the sales side of it.

That's this role. You'll own the analytics behind pipeline, funnel conversion and GTM planning, and partner with RevOps on the forecast - sitting inside the data team, embedded with RevOps and Sales, and in the room when the plan gets made.

Title: Data Analyst Senior Consultant - GA4
Description:
En JAKALA ayudamos a las organizaciones a crecer combinando datos, inteligencia artificial, tecnología y negocio. Contamos con más de 3.400 profesionales en 21 países que trabajan cada día para transformar la información en decisiones y las decisiones en resultados.




Actualmente buscamos un/a Analytics Senior Consultant.

Para este rol necesitamos un/a profesional con capacidad para gestionar retos complejos, aportar criterio y actuar como referente dentro de su ámbito de especialización. Esperamos que trabajes con un alto grado de autonomía, colabores con diferentes equipos y contribuyas tanto al éxito de los proyectos como al desarrollo de las personas que te rodean.




Este rol se engloba dentro del área de Business Analytics. El área de Business Analytics proporciona una visión real del rendimiento de los activos digitales de nuestros clientes, identificando oportunidades de mejora, tendencias de comportamiento y palancas de crecimiento. Combina disciplinas como Business Intelligence y Digital Analytics para convertir los datos en una herramienta clave para optimizar resultados de negocio y la toma de decisiones.




Ubicación: Oficina de JAKALA en Madrid, Barcelona, Gijón o Pamplona.

Si solo te planteas la opción 100% remoto, estamos abiertos también a esta modalidad :)




Funciones:




Apoyar en el día a día analítico con equipos multi-stakeholder (Marketing, Producto, Corporate, Data y Tecnología), asegurando calidad, plazos y alcance.
Exploración y explotación de datos mediante BigQuery y SQL.
Analizar rendimiento y comportamiento End-To-End (adquisición-comportamiento digital-conversión) y traducirlo en insights accionables.
Participar en el diseño del marco de medición (objetivos, eventos, dimensiones) y su evolución en el tiempo.
Supervisar la calidad del dato: validación continua, auditorías, control de cambios y consistencia de métricas.
Apoyo en la generación de documentación de soluciones de medición y trazabilidad para equipo multidisciplinar (Analytics, Media, Data Collection, AI)
Apoyo en diseño y mantenimiento de reporting y dashboards ejecutivos/operativos, garantizando trazabilidad y lectura accionable.
Presentación de propuestas analíticas a equipos internacionales
Participación en diseño funcional y QA de agentes de IA




Requisitos

Al menos 4 años de experiencia trabajando en proyectos en Digital Analytics / Business Intelligence.
Inglés medio-alto. Se trabajará en un proyecto internacional.

Herramientas core (imprescindible)

GA4
SQL para exportación/análisis (p. ej., BigQuery)
Visualización/reporting: Data Studio

Herramientas complementarias (valorable)

Adobe Analytics (valorable)
Visualización/reporting: Power BI
TMS / tagging: GTM, Tealium
App analytics: Firebase
Cuali/UX analytics: Contentsquare, Quantum Metric
CMP/privacidad: OneTrust
MMP / atribución móvil: AppsFlyer.

Conocimientos técnicos (plus)

Entendimiento práctico de data layer y troubleshooting de medición
Integración con plataformas de activación (ads/CRM)




Competencias clave

Foco en análisis: generación de insights y recomendaciones.
Capacidad de priorizar y organizar trabajo en entornos multi-stakeholder.
Comunicación clara, con capacidad de explicar insights a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.
Proactividad en propuesta de soluciones o nuevas iniciativas a abordar.
Trasversalidad entre el área Analítica y de Inteligencia de Cliente.




Salario

Jakala cuenta con bandas salariales objetivas y alineadas con criterios de equidad interna y transparencia retributiva. La banda salarial asociada a esta posición se compartirá desde la primera conversación con Talent Acquisition para garantizar un proceso transparente e informado.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contamos con distintos career paths que te permitirán evolucionar tanto desde la especialización técnica sin necesidad de gestionar equipo, como desde la gestión y liderazgo de personas.
Impulsamos el desarrollo de nuestro talento. En JAKALA apostamos por la promoción interna y ofrecemos oportunidades reales de crecimiento profesional, movilidad y progresión.
Modelo híbrido de asistencia a la oficina (2 días/semana presencial) o remoto.
28 días de vacaciones al año.
Flexibilidad horaria
Tres semanas al año de full remote.
Jornada intensiva en verano (julio y agosto)
Seguro médico.
Wellhub para cuidar tu salud física y mental.
Retribución flexible.
Acceso a formaciones y programas de desarrollo interno como a certificaciones.
Etc.




We are JAKALA

En JAKALA Iberia somos más de 450 empleados repartidos por 4 oficinas (Madrid, Barcelona, Gijón, Pamplona) y en remoto. Trabajamos con las principales empresas de sectores como banca, retail, gran consumo, energia, travel, etc.




Somos una compañía líder en Europa en estrategias basadas en datos e inteligencia artificial, pero nuestro verdadero valor reside en las personas que forman parte de ella.




Fomentamos una cultura abierta, diversa y orientada al aprendizaje continuo, donde cada persona aporta una perspectiva única y desempeña un papel esencial en la consecución de nuestros objetivos. Apostamos por el crecimiento profesional, la colaboración entre equipos y la creación de un entorno en el que las ideas pueden convertirse en resultados. Nuestro lema: Together to get there.




Si te gusta trabajar cerca del negocio, colaborar con especialistas de distintas disciplinas y participar en proyectos donde los datos y la tecnología tienen un impacto real, estaremos encantados de conocerte.

Formarás parte de un proyecto estratégico de analítica digital, enfocado en el análisis de tráfico, consumo y engagement de usuarios, colaborando con diferentes áreas de negocio para convertir los datos en conocimiento accionable y generar impacto real en la estrategia digital.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Dar apoyo al equipo en la elaboración y presentación en PowerPoint de los resultados obtenidos a través del análisis de datos de Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.

Support early-stage ideation initiatives and existing product teams.
Generate insights from usage data and customer behavior.

Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ensure actionable insights.

Analyze usage data and customer behavior to generate insights during early‑stage ideation
Support discovery and experimentation with exploratory analyses and rapid insights

Work closely with product managers to translate questions and hypotheses into analyses

Automate relevant metrics and analyses as products mature
Take analytical ownership for products emerging from ideation initiatives
Stay current with modern analytics techniques and AI‑enabled analytical approaches

Strong experience in data analysis, analytics, or a similar hands‑on role
Excellent analytical thinking and ability to turn data into clear insights
Proficiency with common analytics tools and languages (e.g. Python, SQL, BI tools)
Experience working with product, usage, or behavioral data
Proven interest in AI‑enabled products and modern analytical approaches
Curiosity and motivation to continuously learn and experiment
Comfortable working in early‑stage, exploratory environments
Strong communication skills with technical and non‑technical stakeholders
Fluent in English; German is a plus

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
Formar parte de Aire es unirte a una compañía tecnológica ágil e innovadora. Tenemos el propósito de impulsar a nuestros clientes B2B para que hagan crecer su negocio.

Ofrecemos soluciones avanzadas de Cloud, telecomunicaciones, UCaaS, ciberseguridad y servicios gestionados para empresas, con un modelo centrado en pymes, corporaciones, administraciones públicas y operadores de telecomunicaciones en España y Portugal.

Nos diferenciamos por desarrollar soluciones tecnológicas propias, buscando la excelencia y la cercanía con nuestros clientes. Para ello apostamos por el talento como motor de este proyecto.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

El analista senior de datos, deberá reforzar el equipo de BI aportando un alto nivel técnico en el desarrollo y evolución del ecosistema de datos de negocio y en la generación de informes para dirección y otras áreas, garantizando el cumplimiento de los entregables. Es una posición con un fuerte componente de automatización: se espera que lidere técnicamente la transformación de procesos manuales en procesos automatizados y repetibles, incorporando soluciones de automatización avanzada (incluida la IA) allí donde aporten eficiencia.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?


Trabajar sobre las tablas y el modelo del ecosistema de datos de negocio, colaborando con el equipo en su evolución y mantenimiento.
Construir, mantener y evolucionar informes y cuadros de mando en Power BI y Excel para dirección y otras áreas de negocio.
Interactuar con la capa directiva y con responsables de otras áreas para recoger, entender y priorizar sus necesidades de información.
Garantizar la entrega de los informes y análisis en plazo, recurriendo a soluciones manuales cuando sea necesario para no comprometer el entregable.
Liderar de forma proactiva la automatización de procesos: una vez resuelta la primera entrega, es responsabilidad clave del puesto rediseñar y automatizar el proceso (scripts, programación de tareas, herramientas de automatización e IA cuando aporten valor) para que las siguientes ejecuciones no requieran intervención manual.
Identificar de forma proactiva procesos manuales o repetitivos del equipo susceptibles de automatización, y proponer e implementar soluciones.
Apoyar y coordinarse con el resto del equipo (ETL/Python y Power BI) para repartir y sacar adelante la carga de trabajo mensual.


¿Qué requisitos necesitamos?


Entre 4 y 5 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, analítica de datos o similar.
Nivel avanzado de SQL y MySQL.
Nivel medio de Python.
Nivel avanzado de Power BI (modelado de datos y DAX).
Nivel avanzado de Excel.
Inglés nivel medio (uso ocasional, no intensivo).
Capacidad de interlocución con dirección y con responsables de otras áreas.
Experiencia demostrable automatizando procesos de datos e informes (scripting, programación de tareas, herramientas de automatización).


¿Qué valoramos?


Conocimiento o experiencia aplicando IA para la automatización de procesos (por ejemplo, generación de scripts, agentes o herramientas de IA aplicadas a tareas repetitivas).
Experiencia previa liderando o coordinando equipos.
Experiencia en el sector de las telecomunicaciones (Telco).


¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?


Contrato indefinido y jornada completa.
Modalidad de trabajo híbrido
Flexibilidad de entrada
Jornada intensiva durante los meses de verano
23 días hábiles de vacaciones anuales para que te desconectes y recargues energías
¡No te pierdas nada con nuestro Campus Aire University! Accede a toda la formación disponible y revisa las formaciones pasadas para impulsar tu carrera en telecomunicaciones y cloud
Acceso a descuentos del Club Aire, con ofertas increíbles en moda, viajes, entretenimiento, hostelería, motor y electrónica. ¡Aprovecha!
¡Muy buen ambiente de trabajo!


En Aire, creemos firmemente que los equipos diversos e inclusivos impulsan la innovación, la transformación y mejores resultados. Por ello, promovemos y garantizamos la inclusión de todas las personas, sin importar su género, edad, orientación e identidad sexual, cultura, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal. Nuestro compromiso es construir un entorno donde cada persona pueda aportar su talento y crecer profesionalmente.

En Aire, la igualdad nos une, la diversidad nos fortalece.

Title: Mid Product Data Analyst
Description:
Your mission


We're looking for a Mid Product Data Analyst to join our Players tribe. You will own the analytics for a product domain end-to-end: from governing the tracking that captures user behaviour, to running the analyses that shape what gets built next. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to make sure every key decision is grounded in data, not intuition.


What you'll be doing



Design and implement event tracking to capture user interactions and behaviour within your product domain.


Govern tracking quality in your domain: validate that events are firing correctly, maintain the Gold Standard event set, and keep tracking debt under control.


Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor) to accelerate your analytical work; validate AI-assisted output for accuracy and business context before it influences decisions.


Analyze user funnel drop-offs to identify root causes of friction and lost conversions.


Evaluate A/B test results to assess the impact of product changes, and make sound recommendations even when results are inconclusive.


Build and maintain dashboards to track product performance and KPIs across your domain.


Work closely with data engineers and analytics engineers to co-create reliable data products and pipelines.


Run structured analyses across multiple data sources to surface trends and product opportunities.


Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and designers to embed data in every product decision.


Translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations for product improvement and feature development.



Our ideal player



Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science, or related fields.


Minimum 2 years of experience in data analytics or a similar role, ideally with more than 1 year in product analytics.


Strong SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases.


Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.


Understanding of experimentation (A/B Testing, Multivariate Testing).


Familiarity with event-based analytics tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude.


Basic understanding of machine learning and data engineering concepts.


Basic knowledge of programming languages like Python or R.


Good communication and presentation skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.



Extra points



Experience using AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar) in a data or analytics workflow, including building prototypes.


Experience in a marketplace.


Cloud data warehouse experience (Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, or similar).


Knowledge of dbt or other data pipeline tools.


Experience with predictive modeling (Forecasting, MMM, Neural Networks).


Based in Madrid or Barcelona, Spain.



Our hiring process



People Interview — First contact and cultural fit at Playtomic.


Technical Interview — With our Product Analytics Manager.


Stakeholders Interview — With a PM and Head of Data.


Final Cultural Interview — With our Product Lead.





About PLAYTOMIC




We are the world's largest racket sports App for players and clubs. Our goal is to socialize sports practice: through the app, players can book courts, find other players with similar skill levels, and join a social community dedicated to playing.




Since 2017, Playtomic has earned the trust of national and international investors, consolidating it as one of the main world players in sports digitalization. You will find +150 co-workers around the world with headquarters in Spain and offices in Madrid, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, Finland, Belgium, the UK, EEUU, and Mexico.

Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.
A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
Meal vouchers.
Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.
Be part of an experienced and international team.
A good vibe working environment.
The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.
Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.
The freedom to innovate, experiment, and help shape smarter ways of working.

Title: Sr Business Analyst
Description:
Senior Business Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience working with consumer, CRM, loyalty, or customer lifecycle data.
Understanding of consumer behavior from acquisition to retention.
Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo.

Por eso, si tienes experiencia como Analista de Datos / Analista Digital y te apasiona transformar datos en insights que impulsen la toma de decisiones, nos comprometemos a potenciar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana? ¡Sigue leyendo!




Formarás parte de un proyecto estratégico de analítica digital, enfocado en el análisis de tráfico, consumo y engagement de usuarios, colaborando con diferentes áreas de negocio para convertir los datos en conocimiento accionable y generar impacto real en la estrategia digital.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Dar apoyo al equipo en la elaboración y presentación en PowerPoint de los resultados obtenidos a través del análisis de datos de Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.
Colaborar en la documentación y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado completas (eventos, parámetros, conversiones y dimensiones personalizadas), garantizando la coherencia y escalabilidad de la medición.
Gestionar y explotar Google Analytics 4 (GA4) como principal herramienta de análisis mediante datos almacenados en BigQuery dentro de un entorno Data Proc.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
Experiencia trabajando con KPIs y métricas enfocadas a objetivos de negocio.
Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
Alta capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y atención al detalle.




Modalidad: Híbrido en Madrid.




¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España contamos con una facturación de 217 millones de euros, 9 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.240 profesionales.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate! 🚀

  • Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.
  • Colaborar en la documentación y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado completas (eventos, parámetros, conversiones y dimensiones personalizadas), garantizando la coherencia y escalabilidad de la medición.
  • Gestionar y explotar Google Analytics 4 (GA4) como principal herramienta de análisis mediante datos almacenados en BigQuery dentro de un entorno Data Proc.
  • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
  • Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
  • Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
  • Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
  • Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
  • Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.


¿Qué buscamos?

  • Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
  • Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
  • Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
  • Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
  • Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
  • Experiencia trabajando con KPIs y métricas enfocadas a objetivos de negocio.
  • Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint.
  • Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
  • Alta capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y atención al detalle.


Modalidad: Híbrido en Madrid.


¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España contamos con una facturación de 217 millones de euros, 9 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.240 profesionales.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.

By joining us as a Senior Product Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in helping Product teams understand how users behave in our product, identify the most important opportunities, and turn those insights into roadmap decisions.

HOW You Will Contribute To The Company

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Product topics (6+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).


You will help Product teams deeply understand user behaviors across Pennylane’s frontend experiences, using tools such as Amplitude and our data warehouse to identify adoption patterns, friction points, opportunities, and risks.
You will turn behavioral data into clear, strategic insights that help Product leaders decide what to build, improve, simplify, or stop.
You will be a real sparring partner for Product leaders, feeding their strategy by anticipating the most important questions, framing the right analyses, and translating findings into product roadmap recommendations.
You will contribute to developing a stronger product measurement mindset across Product, Design, Engineering, and Data: helping teams define success metrics, clarify what needs to be measured, and think about measurement earlier in the product development process.
You will partner with the relevant owners on tracking and implementation when needed, ensuring measurement choices remain pragmatic, actionable, and connected to product decisions.
You will contribute to our self‑service approach to analytics by understanding Product partners’ needs and promoting a data‑driven culture. You will contribute directly to data models in the data warehouse (using dbt) used by Product teams.


WHAT You Can Expect From Your Life At Pennylane

Within one month:


You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of the Product area you support.


Within 3 months:


You will be fully in charge of supporting a Product area, prioritizing your topics with its decision makers and helping them connect user behavior insights to roadmap choices.
You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.


Within 6 months:


You will proactively contribute to the Product area’s roadmap by surfacing strategic opportunities from behavioral analyses.
You will work with Product, Engineering and Data practitioners to improve how we measure product success.
You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.


And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:


Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members,
Increased accountability in project leadership,
Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.


Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:


Have had previous experiences as Product Analyst or Data Analyst working closely with Product teams, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools, and have strong experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude or similar event-based analytics platforms
Are comfortable collaborating with Product Managers and Designers, as well as engineering partners, beyond the data team
You have a strong product and business acumen, and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
Are able to connect user behavior, product usage and business impact into clear strategic recommendations
Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
Are Fluent in English - French is a plus


What does the recruitment process look like?


A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)


What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :


To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity


We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.
