Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : dpo@pennylane.com.

Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to dpo@pennylane.com. Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an dpo@pennylane.com schreiben. Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Title: Data Analyst, Associate
Description:
Position Overview

Employer: DWS Group

Title: Data Analyst, Associate

Location: Madrid

Job Code: placeholder for LinkedIn job wrapping

About DWS:

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.

Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.

We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.

As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

This is your chance to invest in your future.

Read More About DWS And Who We Are Here.

Team / division overview

As a Data Analyst within Corporate Functions Technology, you will perform a broad role supporting data-driven regulatory, business, and strategic initiatives across Corporate Functions. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will analyse data, controls, and processes, provide insights to support decision-making, contribute to governance activities, and help deliver regulatory, audit, and transformation programmes.

Your Responsibilities –

As an Data Analyst, Associate, you will:


Perform data analysis, reconciliations, impact assessments, and data validation and control assessment activities to support business, regulatory, audit, and process, policy, and regulatory initiatives
Analyse data, controls, business processes, and project deliverables to identify trends, risks, gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
Translate business and regulatory requirements into data-driven insights and support the delivery of strategic data initiatives including contributing to systems analysis and design where required.
Support Data Quality issue identification, root cause analysis, tracking, and remediation activities.
Support Data Governance activities, including Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data lineage, metadata management, and control documentation.
Coordinate with business and technology stakeholders to support project delivery, regulatory commitments, and resolution of data-related issues, by maintaining clear plans, tracking actions, and driving follow-through.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, presentations, and status updates for governance forums and management.



We are looking for


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience in data analysis, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.
Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, and Python is advantageous.
Experience working with integrations, interface specifications, data warehouses, data pipelines would be advantageous
Exposure to system design principles, architecture patterns, and integration techniques would be advantageous
Knowledge of Data Quality, Data Governance, or Regulatory Reporting concepts is advantageous.
Experience working with business analysts, data engineers, developers and architects
Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience within financial services or a regulatory environment is preferred.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.



What we’ll offer you:

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work - feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.

DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.

If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.

Our values define the working environment we strive to create – diverse, supportive and welcoming of different views. We embrace a culture reflecting a variety of perspectives, insights and backgrounds to drive innovation. We build talented and diverse teams to drive business results and encourage our people to develop to their full potential. Talk to us about flexible work arrangements and other initiatives we offer.

We promote good working relationships and encourage high standards of conduct and work performance. We welcome applications from talented people from all cultures, countries, races, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, beliefs and generations and are committed to providing a working environment free from harassment, discrimination and retaliation.

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

  • Analyse data, controls, business processes, and project deliverables to identify trends, risks, gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into data-driven insights and support the delivery of strategic data initiatives including contributing to systems analysis and design where required.
  • Support Data Quality issue identification, root cause analysis, tracking, and remediation activities.
  • Support Data Governance activities, including Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data lineage, metadata management, and control documentation.
  • Coordinate with business and technology stakeholders to support project delivery, regulatory commitments, and resolution of data-related issues, by maintaining clear plans, tracking actions, and driving follow-through.
  • Prepare management reports, dashboards, presentations, and status updates for governance forums and management.


We are looking for

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in data analysis, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, and Python is advantageous.
  • Experience working with integrations, interface specifications, data warehouses, data pipelines would be advantageous
  • Exposure to system design principles, architecture patterns, and integration techniques would be advantageous
  • Knowledge of Data Quality, Data Governance, or Regulatory Reporting concepts is advantageous.
  • Experience working with business analysts, data engineers, developers and architects
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Title: Data / Research & Insights Analyst
Description:
About SAMY

SAMY is a global network of independent marketing and communications agencies, using research, technology, strategy, creativity, and performance to deliver impactful, data-driven solutions and drive growth for brands. With over 1000 employees in 15+ offices across 18 countries (Europe, U.S., Latin America) and operating in 55 markets, SAMY serves over 100 leading clients, specializing in award-winning, end-to-end digital campaigns.

Our vision is to lead the evolution of brand communication. At our core, we are Bold, Human and Transformative. We are adventurous. SAMY is where your career pushes boundaries and unlocks your highest potential. We were born with a desire to go further. To defy the status quo. To reshape our world. This is your opportunity to work around the globe. With exciting clients. In projects that shape the industry.

Mission

We are seeking a Data / Research & Insights Senior Analyst to join our dynamic team. This role is instrumental in transforming data into strategic insights that drive decision-making, shape innovative campaigns, and optimize business performance.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with strategic thinking, proactively identifying opportunities and influencing both creative and business outcomes.

Job Functions

Data Analysis & Insights


Translate complex and large datasets into clear, actionable insights with strategic implications.
Analyze performance metrics across campaigns, identifying patterns, drivers of success, and optimization opportunities.
Develop, refine, and evolve benchmark frameworks and measurement methodologies aligned with industry standards and client objectives.
Provide proactive recommendations that directly impact campaign performance and business results.
Identify emerging trends and translate them into forward-looking insights, using trendhacking techniques and structured frameworks to drive actionable opportunities for brands and campaigns.


Social Listening & Market Research


Lead the use of social listening tools (e.g., Sprinklr, Talkwalker, Brandwatch, Synthesio, NetBase, Socialbakers) to extract deep consumer insights, cultural trends, and competitive intelligence.
Design and execute research projects that support strategic planning, new business, and client growth initiatives.
Translate industry trends and innovations into strategic recommendations that drive business growth and competitive advantage.


Reporting & Stakeholder Management


Own the development of high-impact reports and presentations, translating data into compelling narratives for clients and internal stakeholders.
Deliver monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc analyses on brand performance, category dynamics, and competitive landscape.
Collaborate cross-functionally with strategy, creative, and account teams, acting as a key partner in shaping data-informed decisions.
Contribute to improving reporting frameworks, storytelling standards, and analytical processes.


,

Skills And Experience


Experience in data analysis, insights, or digital marketing analytics.
Proven ability to connect data with business and strategic outcomes.
Strong analytical thinking with attention to detail and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive, curious, and solution-oriented mindset with a drive for continuous improvement.
Languages: Spanish native, English full working proficiency (written and verbal).
Hands-on experience with social listening tools and end-to-end insight generation (setup → analysis → storytelling).
Strong understanding of digital marketing ecosystem, social platforms, and influencer marketing KPIs.


Cultural Fit

Beyond experience, we look for people who truly connect with the way we work

We are kind and direct, communicating clearly, honestly, and respectfully.

We collaborate without silos or egos, valuing collective success and recognizing that every idea counts.

We give feedback that helps others grow, learning from each other and celebrating progress.

We take pride in our work, paying attention to detail and committing to excellence.

And we take ownership of what we build, showing initiative, responsibility, and delivering real results.

We thrive with people who are kind, collaborative, driven by excellence, and committed to making an impact. If this sounds like you, you’ll thrive at SAMY.

Diversity and Inclusion

At SAMY, we believe in real diversity: teams where each person contributes from their uniqueness. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier-free environment where every voice matters.

We welcome applicants of all abilities and backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process or in your daily work, please let us know. We want you to thrive on an equal footing.

Benefits


Flexible schedule and hybrid work options that help you balance your time and work in a way that fits your life.
A geographic mobility plan that gives you the chance to explore new opportunities and work from different SAMY locations around the world.
Celebrate your birthday with a day off, and take time to enjoy December 24th and 31st as company holidays to relax, recharge, and enjoy what matters most.
Global social and environmental activities that allow you to take part in initiatives that create a positive impact under the OWN THE IMPACT framework, connecting with colleagues from around the world and contributing to projects that make a difference.
Mirror Club is our mentoring program designed to accelerate the careers of talented women by connecting them with experienced mentors.
Global Referral Program that lets you refer clients, projects, or teammates, helping SAMY grow stronger while earning rewards for your contributions.

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We are now looking for a Data Analyst for Finance to join our team in Barcelona (hybrid). The Finance Data Analytics team has been transformative during the last two years by helping our stakeholders succeed in their mission. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform

and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.


Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – 7.7M members in Prime since launching in 2017.
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription program, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalized service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Finance Data Analyst you will be in charge of:


Responsible for execution of key analysis, being the data entry point for the business team and including taking ownership of the different data sources from the business side. Understand the business needs, gather the data and present the key insights: “Contribute to the Finance strategic roadmap with numbers”
Elaborate business cases to support strategic decisions
Create dashboards and tracking: master the internal Business Intelligence tools to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs. Work with data engineering and data science teams to be able to leverage all our internal data
Contribute to the delivery of Finance strategic projects: participate in the delivery of the key internal projects, giving support from the business side to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes.



what do you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
2-4 years experience in a role with strong analytical component
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement,
Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc)
Strong analytical skills, fast-learner, with high attention to detail and focused on results and productivity
Business Proficiency in English and fluent in Spanish
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Looker Studio),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management (as Google Cloud Platform),
SAP knowledge.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



and what's in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, paddle tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key of our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but you do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Description:
Location: Come and join us in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona!

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our operational squads. In this role you will be able to become an expert in our business and data analysis systems and environment to allow you to champion data-driven decisions as part of the Data Operations team.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Focus on analysing and presenting recommendations/process changes/new initiatives to management using insights derived from data.
Use your technical skills such as actively engaging in configuration and programming in the data environment, querying data via SQL from the data lake, automating data processes, deep dive analysis in Python and adjusting ETL tasks.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
Develop monitoring tools to measure performance and help the business achieve its objectives.
Create queries to answer operational and business questions across our many operational teams to support decisions.
Communicate results in a clear and impactful manner.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


Educated to Degree Level or higher in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science or Economics
5+ years of experience in an analytical role
You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Curiosity about AI and its practical applications in analytics, experience using LLMs or AI-powered tools in a data context
Excellent technical skills including SQL knowledge, familiarity with visualisation tools (Metabase in particular is a plus) and python/R
Enthusiastic, outgoing and personable - you have the ability to think on your feet, work independently and also proactively with others to find solutions to issues
You understand how to engage and influence decision makers and have excellent communication skills
Driven - you are motivated to find solutions to problems and constantly go the extra mile
Strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as excellent written and spoken English


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Title: Senior Data Analyst – Performance Analytics & AI
Description:
As Senior Data Analyst – Performance Analytics & AI, you will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights and supporting data-driven decision-making at executive level. The role will initially report to the Head of Group Performance Improvement and is expected to transition into Omya Services & Solutions over time.

Key Responsibilities


Translate SAP and enterprise data into reliable, structured, and decision-ready management insights.
Interpretate performance data, including profitability drivers, margin leakage, cost structures and value improvement opportunities.
Build and maintain analytical models and dashboards to support Group Performance Improvement priorities.
Translate analytical outputs into financially sound conclusions and value improvement actions.
Enable KPI and value realization tracking by developing the technical reporting logic, visualization layer, and data refresh processes.
Apply AI-enabled tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of performance analytics and digital capabilities.
Engage with Finance and Business teams to connect data insights to business realities and conversion into measurable value creation.


Key Requirements


University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or performance reporting, ideally within an international environment.
Hands-on experience with SAP and enterprise reporting environments, combined with strong agility in applying AI-enabled tools.
Strong expertise in data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar platforms.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced international environment.
Collaborative mindset, proactive listening skills, curiosity, and solid business acumen.


What do we offer?


Hybrid Work Model: Flexibility to work from home and in the office according to company policy, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
Ticket Restaurant: Daily meal allowance to support your well-being.
Flexible retribution: Kindergarten & Transport benefits.
30 Labor Days of Holidays per year: Ample time off to relax and recharge.
Language Lessons: Access to language lessons to support personal and professional growth.
Medical Insurance: 60% company-subsidized medical insurance for employees, with the option to extend coverage to family members at a competitive rate.
Open and Modern Office Environment: Work in a collaborative, innovative, and comfortable space designed for your success.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




🎯 Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, using data to recommend customer experience optimization strategies.
Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments that support product development.
Work with Operations Program leadership to define measurement strategies for program health and operational performance.
Establish comprehensive metrics, develop clear reporting, and create regular monitoring processes.
Analyze key customer experience and operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities for deeper research.
Develop and present concise narratives from analytical findings to senior Operations leaders, highlighting problems and proposed solutions.
Support the development and maintenance of core reporting abstractions built in dbt, business intelligence reporting, and AI semantic layers.

🛠️ Requirements

At least 4 years of experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision-making.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment design.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and results to business partners clearly, concisely, and meaningfully.
Ability to independently translate stakeholder questions into clear, actionable analytical problems.
Experience building data abstractions with tools such as dbt or Airflow.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Mode, Looker, Periscope, or Tableau.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including the ability to confidently review code written by other analysts and data scientists.

➕ Nice to have

Master’s degree in a quantitative field or professional experience applying statistics.
Ability to code in Python or R.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for analytics.
Experience working with customer service datasets, such as Zendesk.
Experience with workforce forecasting.

💰 Compensation

First-year salary range in the greater Barcelona area: €47,124–€60,319.
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout.
Benefits are available to full-time employees.
Cash compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities demonstrated throughout the interview and hiring process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing


Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.


What You Will Bring To Ogury


Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.


How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:


A competitive compensation package
Comprehensive benefits coverage
Meal voucher
Holiday and leave allowance, in addition to national holidays
A strong focus on the well-being of our team members, with access to both physical and mental health resources
Flexible Working Model: At Ogury, we believe in the power of presence to fuel innovation. Our hybrid approach is centered on two core in-office collaboration days to drive team synergy, plus one additional office day of your choosing to support personal balance. This 3-day baseline ensures strong connection and real-time problem-solving, while allowing for flexibility across the rest of the week.
And more


We thank you in advance for your interest in Ogury!

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive candidate experience. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us. In accordance with applicable laws, we will work with you to provide reasonable support and ensure a fair hiring process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - B2B
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

This role is embedded within either the B2B domain and is part of Preply’s Data Chapter. You will work closely with directors, B2B leaders, and cross-functional partners across finance and product teams, while collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers to strengthen analytical foundations and business impact.

What you’ll be doing:


Partner with senior stakeholders across Business and Operations to proactively identify where new analyses, metrics, or frameworks can unlock improvements in retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.
Build and own the analytical framework leadership uses to evaluate B2B trade-offs, and define the long-term measurement framework that identifies structural growth levers, not just incremental wins.
Lead high-complexity, end-to-end analytical initiatives — including retention and cohort analyses that answer specific open questions from B2B leadership — uncovering root causes behind revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, and cost efficiency, and turning findings into concrete pricing, product, or lifecycle recommendations.
Own impact modeling, scenario analysis, and KPI governance for B2B: resolve conflicting metric definitions across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Product, maintain a single source of truth, and feed directly into quarterly and annual planning.
Design the experimentation and analytics agenda, what gets tested, how success is measured, and translate results into executive-ready storytelling that aligns stakeholders on goals and trade-offs.
Partner with Directors and VPs to shape B2B strategy, embed analytics into daily decision-making, and mentor senior analysts to raise the analytical bar.


What you need to succeed:


5+ years of experience in analytics roles (ideally in B2B), with demonstrated ownership of KPI frameworks and measurable impact on retention, revenue, or efficiency.
You can point to specific decisions (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and one where your recommendation was rejected, with the judgment to explain why, in hindsight, that was right or wrong.
You've owned a metric or strategic framework other teams were required to use, and resolved a conflict between two teams who each wanted a different definition to win.
Deep understanding of retention and performance metrics (revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, cost efficiency), and the ability to build an LTV or cohort model from scratch, not just interpret one someone else built.
Strong, independent SQL, you're the person other analysts send their code to for review; proven ability to lead cross-functional analytical projects end-to-end.
Strong business acumen and stakeholder influence: comfortable saying no to a request that wasn't the right question, clarifying trade-offs in metrics and resourcing, and building forecast or scenario models that leadership uses to defend a bet to their own leadership.


Nice to have:


Background in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or account-based business models; exposure to customer support operations.
Experience building or scaling an analytics function (hiring, tooling, process, KPI frameworks).
Hands-on experience with Looker, Snowflake, Tableau, or Power BI.
Working knowledge of Python for analysis.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.


Why you’ll love it at Preply:


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)

Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions

Title: Data Analyst - Investments
Description:
Data Analyst - Investments

Summary

We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Investments team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products.

About The Opportunity

As a Data Analyst, you will enable our product and business segments in the Financial Empowerment domain, specifically Investments, to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams' initiatives, helping to drive the strategy of your business segment. You will apply robust analytical approaches, including experimentation and causal inference methods where appropriate, to understand the impact of product and business decisions on customer and business outcomes. You are here to establish a data mindset and thereby foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross-functional setup, collaborating closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In This Role, You Will


Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities.
Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions.
Evaluate initiatives: Support product experimentation and impact measurement initiatives; design experiments and causal inference analyses, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analyses, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise, empathic communication.
Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves.
Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs.
Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.
Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.
Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to):
Support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points and business opportunities.
Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.
Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.
During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.
Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

Background

What you need to be successful:


3+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field.
1+ years of experience in the Investments or Wealth domain


Skills


Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data (e.g. causal inference)
Strong problem solving skills and is comfortable doing exploratory data analysis that generates insights and “so whats”
Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics
Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)
Good presentation skills and communication skills.
Experience with Experimentation (e.g. AB testing, multivariate etc)


What’s In It For You


Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most innovative banks 🚀.
Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.


Who we are?

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position!

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do

  • Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
  • Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
  • Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
  • Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
  • Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
  • Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona

Requisitos

  • 2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
  • Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
  • SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
  • Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
  • Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
  • Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.

Nice-to-have:

  • Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
  • Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
  • Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.

Eres la persona que buscamos si...

  • Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
  • Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
  • Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho

Información adicional

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Crearás dashboards y visualizaciones en Power BI que guíen decisiones estratégicas.

Realizarás consultas y análisis en SQL, generando información precisa y accionable.
Traducirás datos complejos en historias que inspiren a actuar.




🎯 Qué te hará tener éxito en esta posición




✅ Dominio técnico y curiosidad constante

Conocimientos en Power BI, SQL, Excel y modelado te darán autonomía para avanzar; la curiosidad te mantendrá creciendo cada día.




✅ Visión global y pensamiento estructurado

Entender cómo se conectan los sistemas y procesos te ayudará a construir modelos de datos sólidos y sostenibles.

Transformarás la información en historias comprensibles, que inspiren decisiones y generen impacto real.

Gestión del talento

Title: Data Analyst - Everyday Banking
Description:
Summary

We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Everyday Banking team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products.

About The Opportunity

As a Data Analyst (Product) you will enable our product and business segments (Cards, Payments in the Everyday Banking domain to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams’ initiatives, as well as help drive the strategy of your business segment. You are here to establish a data-mindset and thereby to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross functional setup, working closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In This Role, You Will


Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities.
Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions.
Evaluate initiatives: Support Product experimentation & A/B testing initiatives; design test plans, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analysis, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise and empathic communication.
Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product and business teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves.
Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs.
Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.
Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.
Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to):
You support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points, business opportunities and defining success metrics and targets.
Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.
Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.
During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.
Design, conduct and analyze A/B tests
Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

Background

What you need to be successful:

3+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field.

Skills


Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data
Strong problem solving skills and is comfortable doing exploratory data analysis that generates insights and “so whats”
Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics
Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)
Good presentation skills and communication skills.
Experience with A/B Testing & Product Analytics
Having experience with cards y/or payments domains in high growth startups would be a big plus
Having experience in quantitative research would be a plus
Having experience in fintech would be a plus
Having experience with AI Analytics would be a plus


What’s In It For You


Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors.
Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account, as well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.


Who we are

We’ve eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Title: Senior Data Analyst - Expansion
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Expansion leadership on major transformation initiatives shaping the value proposition, business model, customer experience, monetization strategy, and operational playbook for new geographies, segments, and product lines.
Evaluate and prioritize new market entries, customer segments, and strategic bets through rigorous market sizing, competitive benchmarking, and customer analysis
Run focused, data-driven deep dives into expansion-stage customer behavior, unit economics, funnel performance, and competitive dynamics to surface where to double down and where to pivot.
Lead cross-functional performance analyses across Expansion workstreams — surfacing trends, explaining the drivers behind new-market KPIs, and delivering clear, actionable insights to the executive team.
Build the analytical models that underpin Expansion decisions: market sizing and TAM/SAM/SOM models, ramp and forecasting models for new launches, scenario models to pressure-test strategic options, and financial models to quantify the upside (and downside) of each bet.


What You Need To Succeed


5+ years of experience in business analytics, product analytics, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, capable of influencing Leadership-level stakeholders.
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
A proactive, curious mindset with a drive to investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives.
Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous, structured approach to analysis.
Proven Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills (e.g., driver-based modeling, sensitivity analysis, financial impact estimation).
Experience leading cross-functional analytics projects and engaging diverse stakeholders.


Nice to have


Experience in corporate strategy or strategic consulting, with a track record of supporting senior leadership on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives
Experience in fast-growing, data-driven startups, marketplaces, or subscription businesses
Hands-on experience with Looker and Snowflake


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.
