Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group, a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to ServiZurich. Established in Barcelona in 2006, ServiZurich operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In addition to our technological solutions, we excel in investment, administration, and accounting, ensuring comprehensive support for Zurich's diverse operations.

What Can You Expect?

Zurich Global Employee Benefits Solutions (ZGEBS) is a business unit within Zurich Insurance Group whose objective is to support multinational customers in structuring global employee benefits solutions that cover local and/or international employees in multiple countries. ZGEBS manages and operates captive, pooling and International Program (ZIPE) solutions that combine local insurance policies – provided by local Zurich units or selected external partners – into a reinsurance arrangement for multinational customers. These offerings cover employee benefits insurance risks such as death, disability, accident and medical coverages.

We are excited to invite applications to implement our ambitious objective to grow and expand our business around the world.

The Data Analyst works cross functionally with Sales, Underwriting and Finance to deliver key services to out global customers, including portfolio analysis and performance reporting.

You have experience in working in a fast paced international business environment, analytic thinker who likes to solve problems and deliver service excellence in collaboration with different stakeholders. You like to work in a dynamic team where activities are based on capabilities, skills and willingness to help each other.

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at Zurich? I’m glad you asked – I asked myself the same question at the time.

As a Financial Data Analyst you will have the opportunity to:


Manage relationship and activities related to our Network Partners and Customers
Producing professional Customer and Network Partners data analytics / reports
Streamlinining processes and data analysis to ensure excellent delivery standard
Monitoring portfolio data and performance
Proactively ensuring customer satisfaction through the monitoring and implementation of related metrics.
Establishing best practice to optimize end service delivery
Ensuring financial and accounting closing are performed according to deadlines
Actively collaborating with other teams and Subject Matter Experts to identify relevant data sources, help develop and improve operational and customer reports
Previous experience in consulting or auditing is a plus
Work alongside experts in various technological domains.
Enhance your skills with real-world experience
Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity.


What Makes You a Great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!


A university degree, preferably in an analytical numerical field (Finance / Accounting, Data Science, Math, or Statistics)
Relevant work experience of 3-5 years related to the above mentioned responsibilities
Basic knowledge in the insurance business is preferred.
Excellent understanding of data administration and management functions (collection, analysis, distribution etc.)
Ability to work with large data sets across different business segments and extrapolate findings to support decision-making
Communication, presentation, project management and relationship skills
Proven experience in financial reporting and/or accounting; strong understanding of financial data processes is essential.
Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced Excel knowledge; experience in Power BI or similar data visualization tools preferred.
English at business fluency level (written and spoken), as the role is customer-facing and requires communication with international stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage deadlines under pressure.
Team player with proactive attitude and attention to detail.


And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus, we offer:


To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.
Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.
Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English and Spanish classes depending on the needs.
Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.
Life and accident insurance.
Collective Life retirement Plan
2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.
Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts
Functional diversity benefits
Different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more


Where Are We Located?

Bac de Roda, Barcelona.

We Are Waiting for You.

It’s a match? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English.

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

ServiZurich– Your Talent, Our Strength

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!

Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence & Data Analyst
Description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Sr Business Intelligence and Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and governing scalable business intelligence solutions and data architectures. The role enables data-driven decision-making across the EMEA commercial organization by transforming complex, multi-source data into actionable insights through robust data models, optimized pipelines, and Power BI reporting.

This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and Business Analytics (EMEA) and is part of the EMEA Sales Operation and Enablement team and will be in Barcelona (Spain) or Prague (Czech Republic) and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To


Design and deliver end-to-end Power BI solutions, including robust data models, interactive dashboards, and scalable semantic layers (e.g., star schemas and data marts).
Build and optimize high-performance data architectures by integrating multiple enterprise sources (ERP, CRM, CPQ) and developing efficient SQL queries.
Establish and govern KPI frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment across business reporting.
Drive data quality, governance, and best practices in data transformation, normalization, documentation, and access control.
Perform advanced analytics, including exploratory data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling to support sales and performance tracking.


The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include


B.Sc./M.Sc. in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or related field.
Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).
Solid knowledge of data architecture principles (data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing).
Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), ERP, and other enterprise systems.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements


Ability to travel 10%


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


Sales Operations, preferably in Sanitary/Pharmaceutical Sector is a plus
Lean Change Management Models, data-driven transformation and continuous improvement methodologies in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities
Experience with Lean or data-driven transformation methodologies is a plus.


Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefits that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programmes contribute to life beyond the job.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We are looking to welcome yet another brilliant Senior Marketing Data Analyst into our Marketing Analytics team.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be responsible for designing and driving high-impact analytics solutions, from developing advanced statistical frameworks to evaluate marketing performance, to building data pipelines that integrate third-party sources, to creating interactive tools that empower partner teams. These are just a few examples of the initiatives you’ll help lead and deliver end-to-end, playing a key role in shaping the technical direction of our analytics efforts. The demands on this team are constantly evolving with the needs of Socialpoint’s and Zynga’s dynamic marketing teams, so it is important that you be able to adapt and utilize your time efficiently.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with marketing and cross-functional teams to identify growth opportunities, improve efficiency, and shape strategic initiatives.
Lead analytical deep dives to surface insights and translate them into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Visualize and communicate analytical findings clearly, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Apply statistical methodologies to evaluate performance and account for uncertainties in major initiatives.
Proactively explore and prototype opportunities using AI-driven automation to streamline investigations and improve decision-making.


What You Bring


Demonstrated experience with some or all of the following: predictive modeling, statistics, experimental design, optimization, data visualization
Understanding of marketing metrics and KPIs, with experience in campaign optimization, Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling, and incrementality analysis
Proficiency in SQL and Python with hands-on experience in Redshift, Databricks, PySpark, and Airflow
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguous questions into data-driven insights
Strong communication skills — you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus
A team player, you establish effective relationships to work with others for the win
Proven work experience in data analytics or data science roles
BS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative field; Masters, MBA or PhD preferred


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)


The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English.

Description:
We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst, someone who is strong on in defining what healthy looks like, challenging investment decisions with data and setting the standard.


Your responsibilities:

Elevate the bar for the team, set methodology standards, challenge analytical approaches, and mentor analysts on quality, rigor.

Own the A/B test framework end to end: design, evaluation methodology, and standards for how results are interpreted and acted on

Translate business questions into data model requirements and coordinate with the Data Core team to build the layers that power analytical work across the game

Proactively surface insights for the product team, not just answering questions, but identifying what questions should be asked

Set and own the standards for how analytical findings reach designers, PMs, and Live Ops: format, cadence, and whether it actually influenced decisions

Experience in mobile gaming analytics, worked on live games across the full release cycle, with direct experience in retention and monetization mechanics influencing outcomes

Strong statistical foundations: designed and evaluated A/B tests end to end, and knows what to do when conditions aren't clean

Track record of building KPI frameworks from first principles, defining what matters for the specific game and context rather than defaulting to industry convention

Evidence-first: forms strong positions from data, defends them under pressure, but stays open to changing course when the evidence calls for it, the goal is to be correct, not just right.

Able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences

Expert proficiency in SQL and either R or Python for data exploration and analysis

High autonomy, low maintenance: figures things out quickly, meticulous about what matters, moves with pragmatism and proactivity






Based Paris or Barcelona along with a hybrid working model

Title: Senior Business Analyst - CS Analytics
Description:
About Kiwi.com

Kiwi.com is a leading global travel-tech company headquartered in the Czech Republic. Our innovative algorithm enables users to find better route options and prices other search engines can’t see, daily performing billions of price checks across 95% of global flight content. Are you bold, bright and curious? Join a global business that’s still got a start-up heart.

About Customer Support Analytics Team

We support our Customer Support department to turn complex operational data into thoughtful, high-impact decisions that enhance customer satisfaction and strengthen daily operations. Partnering closely across Product, Finance, and Operations, we build intuitive dashboards and data models to bring real-time visibility to friction points, tracking airline recovery and ensuring accurate, timely refunds. In our AI-native team, you will collaborate directly with key decision-makers, seeing firsthand how your shared insights make the customer journey measurably better.

What You Will Do


Support the analytical side of our refunds operation by building reliable data structures, tracking process flows, and partnering with Finance, Product, and Engineering to optimize airline recovery performance.
Partner with the CS Operations team to turn large-scale datasets into actionable insights that support agent productivity, queue management, and customer satisfaction.
Identify inefficiencies across CS Operations and Refunds by acting as a collaborative process expert, leveraging AI tools to support and streamline daily team workflows.
Collaborate closely with Workforce Management and vendor partners to ensure they have accurate, trusted data for volume forecasting, productivity tracking, and headcount modeling.
Co-create automation processes alongside Engineering by evaluating expected efficiency gains and supporting smooth post-implementation transitions.
Maintain and improve internal data pipelines by writing optimized SQL queries that extract meaningful insights and keep shared reporting tools up to date.
Connect with senior leadership by developing clear, empathetic, and data-backed narratives that articulate operational challenges while offering thoughtful solutions.


What You Will Need


A proven track record in a business analytics role, with experience translating complex operational data into supportive business decisions—ideally within a Customer Support environment.
Strong proficiency in SQL, with confidence writing and managing your own queries, understanding underlying data structures, and supporting peers through code reviews.
Demonstrated experience with Data Visualization tools (such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI) to build, refine, and maintain accessible, insight-rich dashboards.
A natural curiosity for AI tools, actively exploring new ways to make work sharper and faster while sharing discoveries to uplift the wider team.
Professional proficiency level English language skills (written and verbal), with clear, empathetic communication skills when working across diverse stakeholders and senior leadership.


We offer you


We offer a hybrid and flexible work environment. A lovely, modern office in the center of Barcelona (Passeig de Gracia) with great views and amenities.
Monthly entitlement of 200 Euro redeemable through Cobee. Cobee is a benefits platform offering a range of benefits (meals, transport, nursery, health insurance, and physical wellness) and flexible compensation. It also allows our employees to allocate up to 30% of their gross salary to the consumption of certain products or services, leveraging tax exemption.
We also enjoy benefits, such as flexible working hours, 30 paid vacation days and sick days.
Annual financial bonus based on company and individual performance.
Flight vouchers to celebrate your Kiwi anniversaries.

Title: ACES Analyst, ADAT
Description:
Description

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join the ACES Data Analytics Team (ADAT) , supporting operational excellence through data-driven dashboarding solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards and underlying data pipelines that provide actionable insights to operations teams. You will work closely with stakeholders across the support function to translate business needs into analytics solutions that drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities

i) Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that support operational performance tracking and decision-making

ii) Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources

iii) Develop Python scripts for data manipulation, automation, and advanced analytics

iv) Partner with operations stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications

v) Perform root cause analysis on operational metrics, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement

vi) Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all reporting and dashboarding deliverables

vii) Proactively communicate progress, blockers, and risks to stakeholders and leadership

viii) Support KTLO (Keep The Lights On) activities for existing dashboards, including troubleshooting, bug fixes, and enhancements

A day in the life

In particular, Business Analysts will support the team with different types of analyses (from estimating the savings of a new project to calculating the drivers behind the Team’s performance) and work with various stakeholders in Amazon’s Operations. We are looking for profiles with analytics and communication skills, business sense and an excellent knowledge of Excel and the Microsoft Office package.

As a Business Analyst on our team, you own the full cycle from raw data to actionable insight. You write SQL queries to pull operational data from multiple sources, validate it, and transform it into something meaningful. When something looks off in the numbers, you investigate — tracing it back through the pipeline until you find the root cause and flag it to stakeholders before it becomes a problem.

You build and maintain dashboards in QuickSuite that operations teams rely on daily. That means designing layouts, connecting calculated fields, setting up filters, and making sure the right people see the right data at the right level of detail. You iterate on these based on feedback, always looking for ways to make the information clearer and more useful.

You also write Python scripts that automate repetitive work — data validations, scheduled extractions, report generation — things that used to take hours manually and now run in minutes. When a quick ad-hoc analysis comes in from a manager, you use Excel to pivot the data and deliver a clean summary without overengineering it.

Throughout all of this, you share what you find. You communicate insights clearly to stakeholders, walk them through what the data is telling us, and help them make decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions.

About The Team

Our team sits within the ACES organization and provides analytics and dashboarding solutions that support operational functions. We are a medium size, high-impact team focused on delivering clean, scalable, and well-documented analytics that enable data-driven decision-making across operations. We value seamless development practices, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience in a business analyst, data analyst or equivalent role
Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
iii) Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis across large datasets
vi) Proficiency in Excel for ad-hoc analysis and reporting
vii) Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical audiences


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in a logistics/operations environment
Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
Knowledge of SQL/ETL
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
Experience in process design and documentation
Familiarity with Amazon's data ecosystem (Redshift, Andes, S3)

Descripción del puesto:

✨ ¿CUÁL SERÁ TU MISIÓN?

 

En Frit Ravich 🍿 #alimentamosmomentosdevida desde hace más de 60 años. Somos una empresa familiar catalana, referente en nuestro sector, con una clara apuesta por la innovación, los datos y las personas como motor de crecimiento.

 

Buscamos una persona como tú para incorporarte como Revenue Analyst dentro del departamento de Planificación Estratégica y Data. Tendrás la oportunidad de participar en decisiones estratégicas que impactan directamente en la rentabilidad del negocio, trabajando de forma transversal con equipos de Ventas, Marketing, Compras y Data.

 

Tu misión será analizar y optimizar las principales palancas de Revenue Management (precio, promoción, mix y condiciones comerciales), transformando datos en recomendaciones que ayuden a impulsar el crecimiento rentable de la compañía. Aquí no solo analizarás información: contribuirás a mejorar la toma de decisiones de todo el negocio.

 

📅 ¿QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA?

 

Analizarás los factores internos y externos que impactan en la rentabilidad comercial, identificando oportunidades de mejora y proponiendo acciones basadas en datos.
Participarás en la definición, revisión y mantenimiento de precios, colaborando en la construcción de la estrategia de pricing de la compañía.
Evaluarás el impacto y la eficiencia de promociones, campañas y acciones comerciales, extrayendo conclusiones y recomendaciones para los equipos implicados.
Diseñarás y desarrollarás indicadores y herramientas de análisis vinculadas a las diferentes palancas de Revenue Management.
Colaborarás con Marketing, Compras y Ventas en lanzamientos, campañas y proyectos estratégicos, asegurando que las decisiones comerciales estén respaldadas por información sólida.
Participarás en proyectos transversales de analítica avanzada, mejora continua y desarrollo de nuevas capacidades de negocio basadas en datos.
Darás soporte a clientes en el uso de Frit Ravich Data Solutions, ayudándoles a obtener valor a través del análisis de información de mercado.

 



Descripción del perfil:

✅ QUÉ BUSCAMOS EN TI

 

Eres una persona analítica, rigurosa y orientada a resultados.
Te gusta entender el porqué de los números y convertir los datos en decisiones.
Tienes formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Contabilidad y Finanzas o similar.

 

Además, valoraremos muy positivamente si:

 

Tienes experiencia o conocimientos en pricing, controlling comercial, revenue management o análisis de negocio.
Dominas Excel y te sientes cómodo/a trabajando con grandes volúmenes de información.
Conoces herramientas como SAP, Power BI, QlikView o Python.
Te gusta colaborar con diferentes equipos y comunicar conclusiones de forma clara y estructurada.
Tienes iniciativa, capacidad de organización y orientación a la mejora continua.
 

¿Te atreves a convertir los datos en decisiones que impulsen el crecimiento de Frit Ravich?

 

 



Ofrecemos:

Plan de acompañamiento desde el primer día.
Proyecto estable con contrato indefinido en una empresa en crecimiento constante.
Participación en proyectos estratégicos con impacto directo en la rentabilidad y evolución del negocio.
Entorno innovador, donde los datos son una herramienta clave para la toma de decisiones.
Descuentos en nuestros productos🍿🥜
Horario flexible (entrada entre las 8h y las 9:30h) y 29% de teletrabajo.

Title: DS Data Analyst
Description:
Finance Data Analyst

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We are now looking for a Data Analyst for Finance to join our team in Barcelona (hybrid). The Finance Data Analytics team has been transformative during the last two years by helping our stakeholders succeed in their mission. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform

and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.


Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – 7.7M members in Prime since launching in 2017.
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription program, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalized service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Finance Data Analyst you will be in charge of:


Responsible for execution of key analysis, being the data entry point for the business team and including taking ownership of the different data sources from the business side. Understand the business needs, gather the data and present the key insights: “Contribute to the Finance strategic roadmap with numbers”
Elaborate business cases to support strategic decisions
Create dashboards and tracking: master the internal Business Intelligence tools to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs. Work with data engineering and data science teams to be able to leverage all our internal data
Contribute to the delivery of Finance strategic projects: participate in the delivery of the key internal projects, giving support from the business side to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes.



what do you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
2-4 years experience in a role with strong analytical component
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement,
Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc)
Strong analytical skills, fast-learner, with high attention to detail and focused on results and productivity
Business Proficiency in English and fluent in Spanish
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Looker Studio),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management (as Google Cloud Platform),
SAP knowledge.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



and what's in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, paddle tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key of our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but you do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Apply now!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to start a new professional challenge? Check out our new opportunity!

We are looking to incorporate a Data Analyst to our team.

🤗 About us

We are an IT Consultant Group that provides services and creates digital solutions to improve the lives of citizens across Europe. Check out our website: www.altia.es/en

🚀 Our project and team

This is your opportunity to start working on international projects with a highly qualified team and applying the latest technologies.

You will join our European team, specifically the one involved in several projects for a significant European Agency.

Minimum Requirements

🧠 Required Knowledge


Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting.
Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable datasets.
High level of English.


✅ Main Responsibilities


Collect and clean data from various sources.
Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.


🔝 Skills:


Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights.
Skill in presenting findings with visuals and storytelling that support decisions.
Commitment to maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity in reporting.
Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
Competence in managing tasks and delivering insights on time.
Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively.
Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
Ability to understand, speak and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.


This job offer has been drafted with impartiality and non-discrimination on the basis of gender, race, ideology or any other grounds in mind. In particular, it complies with current regulations on gender equality between women and men (Royal Decree-Law 6/2019)

Power BI, DAX y Power Query

Title: Analista de Datos BI
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
¿Consideras que tienes una gran capacidad analítica? ¿te apasiona entender el día a día de nuestro negocio? ¡Te estamos buscando!

En Verisure buscamos incorporar un/a Analista de Datos BI para el área de Operational Managament dentro de la Dirección de Operaciones.

La misión de esta posición será el apoyo y seguimiento de los performances operativos de las diferentes áreas de negocio.

Principales Funciones


Realizar análisis exploratorios y explicativos sobre grandes volúmenes de datos, identificando patrones, oportunidades y palancas de mejora para el negocio. Se requiere pensamiento crítico y creativo “out of the box”.
Proporcionar insights a través del análisis que ayuden a la priorización de diferentes proyectos / iniciativas en el negocio.
Colaborar estrechamente con diferentes equipos (Producto, Operaciones, Marketing, Planificación, Financiero) para entender necesidades, traducirlas a soluciones analíticas y asegurar la adopción de resultados
Realizar múltiples reportes automatizados e interactivos que permitan hacer el seguimiento y traccionar principales KPI operativos.
Trabajar con múltiples fuentes de datos (Datos internos- conexiones ODBS, Nube-AWS, Snowflake, ficheros externos), asegurando la calidad, consistencia y correcto modelado de la información.
Detectar desvíos y liderar propuestas para mejorar el servicio.
Tener el governance del dato al construir nuevas métricas, mantener las existentes y detectar posibles incidencias.
Presentaciones ejecutivas para la Dirección de Verisure.


Requisitos Imprescindibles


Titulación universitaria superior: Administración de empresas, Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería, Actuariales o similar.
Inglés, al menos B2.
Habilidades analíticas y cuantitativas excepcionales.
Nivel Avanzado paquete Office (Excel, PPT, Access, Visio)
Imprescindible conocimiento de lenguajes y herramientas como Python, SQL y PowerBI.
Interés por el mundo operativo.
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y múltiples fuentes de información.
Soft skills y capacidad de interactuar y comunicarse con los diversos perfiles y áreas operativas de la compañía.
Capacidad de adaptación a los cambios.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en posiciones similares.
Capacidad analítica avanzada con orientación a resolución de problemas.
Proactividad en busca de la mejora continua.
Trabajo en equipo.


Requisitos Valorables


Conocimientos de Business Objects.
Conocimientos de AWS.
Conocimientos en Snowflake
Conocimientos del uso de IA en reporting y análisis.
Confianza para interactuar con perfiles senior y bajo presión.
Gestión de Proyectos.
Otros idiomas adicionales.


Nuestro ADN: Pasión, Compromiso, Innovación, Trabajo en Equipo, Confianza y Responsabilidad.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Place: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Are you looking for an innovative and established organisation where you can develop your career? Are you passionate about turning data into real impact? This is your chance!

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to drive a data-driven culture across our corporate divisions. You will be part of the Data & Advanced Analytics team, helping to transform information into smarter, more strategic decisions.

You will be part of key initiatives in advanced analytics, data governance and artificial intelligence, driving continuous improvement by identifying opportunities and generating actionable insights. This role combines technical challenges with a strong business acumen, involving you in projects that have a real impact on the organisation’s transformation and evolution.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

Within our team, your main responsibilities will be:


Analysing corporate data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities for improvement that drive decision-making.
Creating dashboards, reports and key performance indicators using visualisation tools that facilitate business interpretation.
Design and develop data integration and transformation processes (ETL/ELT) to ensure data availability and reliability.
Define and build data models aligned with the organisation’s analytical needs.
Ensure the quality, consistency and traceability of data throughout its entire lifecycle.
Work with economic, financial and operational information, ensuring data consistency and correct reconciliation.
Collaborate closely with the various business areas to understand their needs and translate them into high-value analytical solutions.
Participate in data governance initiatives, contributing to the efficient and structured management of corporate data.
Identify opportunities to incorporate Artificial Intelligence and language models (LLMs) into corporate processes.
Drive initiatives for automation, innovation and continuous improvement within the data ecosystem.
Promote a cross-functional view of processes and data, encouraging collaboration between departments.


WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

Previous experience in all the areas described is not essential for this role. We particularly value the ability to learn, intellectual curiosity, a proactive approach and a keen interest in further developing your knowledge of data analytics and artificial intelligence.

We are looking for a professional with analytical skills, critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset. The ability to conceptualise, synthesise and draw conclusions from data, as well as adapt messages to different audiences, and experience in data analysis and exploitation.

Knowledge and experience of the following would be required:


Data visualisation tools (Spotfire, Power BI or similar).
Programming in Python and advanced SQL.
Design and development of ETL processes
Modelling of relational and analytical databases.
Data governance, data quality and metadata management.


The following will be considered an advantage:


Knowledge of applied statistics and quantitative analysis.
Ability to interact with business users and translate functional requirements into technical solutions.
Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI and language models (LLMs), as well as their practical applications in business environments.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
En Carrefour estamos transformando nuestros sistemas centrales para modernizar nuestra actividad principal, el comercio al por menor.




Si quieres ser parte de una empresa dinámica, dentro de un sector con gran potencial de desarrollo que te ofrecerá oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y personal, nos encantará tener la oportunidad de conocerte.




Buscamos un/una Data Analyst para nuestra Dirección de Seguros con el objetivo de analizar los datos de la compañía con eje cliente a través de la minería de los datos, a partir de distintas fuentes y sobre un entorno Big Data y con el objetivo de transformarlos en información accionable para la compañía y generar informes y visualizaciones de datos útiles para la toma de decisiones. Discriminar y separar los datos para ofrecer información relevante a sus clientes. Potenciar e impulsar nuevos planteamientos de análisis orientados al cliente con el objetivo de realizar aportaciones de valor a las unidades de negocio.




Entre sus funciones principales se encuentran:




-Tener una visión clara de negocio con el fin de ayudar a los equipos a mejorar su toma de decisiones con respecto al cliente.

- Ofrecer una visualización de los datos que permita su mejor entendimiento por sus clientes.

- Aportar análisis cuantitativos basados en el histórico de datos internos de los clientes para ofrecer previsiones de comportamiento del mismo a Negocio, con el objetivo de ajustar los esfuerzos comerciales a la tendencia del cliente

- Análisis e interpretación de los resultados a partir de distintas técnicas avanzadas (regresiones, algoritmos matemáticos avanzados…) y de herramientas analíticas para detectar las causas raíz de problemas de áreas de negocio .




Nos encantaría conocerte si cuentas con:




-Titulación de Ingeniero Superior, Matemático o Estadístico.

-Experiencia de 2 años en puestos similares.

-Ingles nivel medio-alto.

-Bases Datos SQL y Data Mining.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido

Salario competitivo (fijo + variable)

Descuento del 8% para ti y para 6 personas más en nuestras tiendas

Programas que se preocupan por tu bienestar:

Carrefour Life (actividades y eventos deportivos, descuentos y ventajas exclusivas)

Carrefour Flexible (retribución flexible para seguro médico, guarderías, transporte…)

Formación continua

Desarrollo profesional




Valoraremos todas las candidaturas interesadas y si eres la persona seleccionada para avanzar en el proceso, nos pondremos en contacto contigo para darte más detalles del puesto y conocer tu perfil.




En Carrefour apostamos por un espacio de trabajo idóneo para que cualquier persona con independencia de su género, orientación sexual, identidad y/o expresión de género, creencias, ideologías, origen, capacidades, entre otras, pueda desplegar todo su potencial.

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


3+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Title: Data Analyst - SQL/BI Specialist, Data Engineer and Database Administrator (DBA) – Real Estate Sector
Description:
Buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst con experiencia de nivel Middle / Mid-Senior, que quiera asumir un papel clave en la transformación y explotación de datos dentro de una compañía líder del sector inmobiliario de lujo. La persona se incorporará a un entorno en crecimiento y tendrá un papel transversal, trabajando con diferentes áreas del negocio para transformar datos en información accionable, indicadores de negocio y herramientas de reporting que faciliten la toma de decisiones.




Responsabilidades

Analizar datos procedentes de diferentes fuentes y sistemas de negocio, principalmente CRM, ERP y otras plataformas corporativas.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes de Business Intelligence, principalmente utilizando Power BI.
Trabajar con SQL para extracción, transformación, análisis y validación de datos, optimizando consultas y procesos cuando sea necesario.
Definir, calcular y hacer seguimiento de KPIs de negocio, asegurando la consistencia y calidad de las métricas utilizadas por las diferentes áreas.
Desarrollar modelos de datos y estructuras analíticas que permitan explotar la información de forma eficiente, escalable y reutilizable.
Analizar tendencias, comportamientos y desviaciones para identificar oportunidades de mejora y proporcionar insights relevantes para el negocio.
Trabajar con las áreas de Sales, Marketing, Operations y Management para comprender sus necesidades de información y convertirlas en soluciones analíticas.
Participar en la mejora y automatización de procesos de reporting, reduciendo tareas manuales y mejorando la disponibilidad y fiabilidad de la información.
Contribuir a la definición de estándares de data quality, governance y reporting, asegurando que los datos sean fiables, consistentes y útiles para la toma de decisiones.
Identificar nuevas oportunidades para utilizar los datos y mejorar la eficiencia comercial y operativa de la compañía.
Elaborar análisis ad hoc, informes ejecutivos y presentaciones para responsables de área y Dirección.




Requisitos

Entre 3 y 6 años de experiencia en posiciones de Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Intelligence o similares.
Experiencia sólida trabajando con SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
Experiencia con Power BI, incluyendo modelado de datos, Power Query y DAX.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos, ETL y procesos de transformación de información.
Capacidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de datos y detectar inconsistencias, patrones y oportunidades.
Experiencia definiendo y monitorizando KPIs de negocio.
Capacidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas concretas.
Nivel de inglés profesional.
Se valorará especialmente experiencia en CRM, Salesforce, real estate, retail, financial services o entornos comerciales, así como conocimientos de herramientas de Data Lake / Cloud.




Buscamos una persona que

Combine una sólida capacidad analítica con una clara orientación a negocio.
Sea capaz de trabajar de forma autónoma, pero también de colaborar con equipos técnicos y de negocio.
Tenga curiosidad por entender cómo funciona el negocio y no se limite únicamente a generar informes.
Sea rigurosa con la calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de los datos.
Tenga capacidad para comunicar información compleja de forma clara y convertir datos en insights que ayuden a tomar mejores decisiones.




🚀Si nos quieres conocer, te podremos aportar...

Proyecto a largo plazo con contrato indefinido.
Medidas horarias que permiten un buen balance para conciliar. Teletrabajo, salida antes los viernes, tarde del cumpleaños libre...
Compensación mixta con variable de bonus anual.
Formación y desarrollo.
Beneficios como seguro médico.
Entorno de trabajo con un equipo orientado a la acción, dinámico y diverso.




El reto

Formarás parte de un proyecto de transformación y crecimiento en el que el dato está adquiriendo un papel cada vez más estratégico. Tendrás la oportunidad de construir, mejorar y profesionalizar el ecosistema de BI y Data de la compañía, trabajando directamente con las áreas de negocio y generando soluciones con impacto real. No buscamos únicamente a alguien que analice datos. Buscamos a alguien capaz de convertir los datos en una herramienta para hacer crecer el negocio.




Si sientes gran afinidad con esta vacante, ¡estaremos esperando tu CV! Muchas gracias por tu tiempo.

Title: Senior Data Analyst – Performance Analytics & AI
Description:
As Senior Data Analyst – Performance Analytics & AI, you will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights and supporting data-driven decision-making at executive level. The role will initially report to the Head of Group Performance Improvement and is expected to transition into Omya Services & Solutions over time.

Key Responsibilities


Translate SAP and enterprise data into reliable, structured, and decision-ready management insights.
Interpretate performance data, including profitability drivers, margin leakage, cost structures and value improvement opportunities.
Build and maintain analytical models and dashboards to support Group Performance Improvement priorities.
Translate analytical outputs into financially sound conclusions and value improvement actions.
Enable KPI and value realization tracking by developing the technical reporting logic, visualization layer, and data refresh processes.
Apply AI-enabled tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of performance analytics and digital capabilities.
Engage with Finance and Business teams to connect data insights to business realities and conversion into measurable value creation.


Key Requirements


University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or performance reporting, ideally within an international environment.
Hands-on experience with SAP and enterprise reporting environments, combined with strong agility in applying AI-enabled tools.
Strong expertise in data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar platforms.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced international environment.
Collaborative mindset, proactive listening skills, curiosity, and solid business acumen.


What do we offer?


Hybrid Work Model: Flexibility to work from home and in the office according to company policy, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
Ticket Restaurant: Daily meal allowance to support your well-being.
Flexible retribution: Kindergarten & Transport benefits.
30 Labor Days of Holidays per year: Ample time off to relax and recharge.
Language Lessons: Access to language lessons to support personal and professional growth.
Medical Insurance: 60% company-subsidized medical insurance for employees, with the option to extend coverage to family members at a competitive rate.
Open and Modern Office Environment: Work in a collaborative, innovative, and comfortable space designed for your success.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




🎯 Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, using data to recommend customer experience optimization strategies.
Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments that support product development.
Work with Operations Program leadership to define measurement strategies for program health and operational performance.
Establish comprehensive metrics, develop clear reporting, and create regular monitoring processes.
Analyze key customer experience and operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities for deeper research.
Develop and present concise narratives from analytical findings to senior Operations leaders, highlighting problems and proposed solutions.
Support the development and maintenance of core reporting abstractions built in dbt, business intelligence reporting, and AI semantic layers.

🛠️ Requirements

At least 4 years of experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision-making.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment design.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and results to business partners clearly, concisely, and meaningfully.
Ability to independently translate stakeholder questions into clear, actionable analytical problems.
Experience building data abstractions with tools such as dbt or Airflow.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Mode, Looker, Periscope, or Tableau.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including the ability to confidently review code written by other analysts and data scientists.

➕ Nice to have

Master’s degree in a quantitative field or professional experience applying statistics.
Ability to code in Python or R.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for analytics.
Experience working with customer service datasets, such as Zendesk.
Experience with workforce forecasting.

💰 Compensation

First-year salary range in the greater Barcelona area: €47,124–€60,319.
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout.
Benefits are available to full-time employees.
Cash compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities demonstrated throughout the interview and hiring process.

Description:
Modalidad: Híbrida

Localización: Madrid

Desde Candee estamos gestionando esta posición de Junior Data Analyst para Ufinet.

¿Qué es Ufinet?

Ufinet es un operador mayorista de telecomunicaciones. Con más de 27 años de experiencia, ha desplegado más de 130.000 km de fibra óptica con una amplia cobertura de red en las principales ciudades de 17 países, principalmente de América Latina.

Pretenden proporcionar conectividad a través de fibra óptica de la manera más flexible y ágil, siempre con un alto compromiso con sus clientes.

Con valores integrados de flexibilidad, agilidad, pasión, compromiso o proximidad, tienen la visión de ser el operador neutral de telecomunicaciones de referencia a nivel mundial.

¿Qué hace que Ufinet sea un sitio único?

Según nos ha contado el equipo de UFINET, lo mejor de trabajar aquí es:

🤝Trabajo en equipo: Un ambiente de compañerismo, respeto y apoyo mutuo. Aquí todos reman en la misma dirección, se celebran los logros juntos y se superan los retos en equipo.

🌎 Crecimiento: UFINET es una empresa en plena expansión, lo que se traduce en oportunidades constantes para evolucionar profesionalmente.

💡Aprendizaje: Oportunidad de aprender constantemente nuevas tecnologías y habilidades dando soluciones a proyectos y problemas reales.

¿Cómo será tu equipo?

Entrarás a formar parte del equipo de Software y Data, bajo el liderazgo de su Chief Data Officer. El equipo tiene una línea de Data Analysis y una línea de Data Engineering liderado por sus respectivos Team Leads y dentro de los cuáles los perfiles están especializados en las diferentes áreas de negocio.

Formarás parte del equipo de Data Analysts, quienes te acompañarán en tu desarrollo como analista de datos.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Tu misión será dar soporte al equipo de analistas de datos y aprender y colaborar con todo lo necesario para realizar una visualización y análisis efectivo de datos.


Dar soporte en la extracción, limpieza y estructuración (ETL) de datos desde diferentes fuentes.
Participar en la construcción de informes que den respuesta a necesidades del equipo corporativo con Power Bi.
Construcción de conjuntos de datos consolidados de diferentes fuentes.
Desarrollo de análisis descriptivos, analítica avanzada e implementación de modelos estadísticos.
Coordinarte con el equipo corporativo, para entender las necesidades del negocio y definir las métricas necesarias para un análisis de datos efectivo.
Colaborar con perfiles más seniors para aprender todo lo necesario para dominar la posición y crecer en la organización.


¿Qué están buscando?


Estudios en ingeniería, física o matemáticas.
Que tengas al menos una experiencia básica/intermedia laboral o en prácticas con SQL y algún lenguaje de programación como Python o Scala.
Que tengas curiosidad e interés por crecer en el mundo del dato.
Esperamos que seas una persona proactiva, flexible, con ganas de aprender y mejorar de manera continua junto con tu equipo.
Que seas una persona con buenas habilidades de comunicación, que sepa trabajar en equipo.
Permiso para trabajar en el país y dominio del español.


Valoraremos positivamente:


Que tengas experiencia con Power BI u otra herramienta de visualización de datos.
Que estés familiarizadx con la metodología Scrum y conozcas GitHub.
Te defiendas con el inglés (B2).


¿Qué ofrecen?


Modalidad híbrida de trabajo, con oficinas situadas en Paseo de la Castellana 47, Madrid.
Horario flexible: Entrada de 8h a 11h y horario de salida en consecuencia.
Mes de Agosto con Jornada Intensiva y Reducida.
Ticket Restaurant.
Seguro Médico con Adeslas.
Formación a demanda en función de tu interés/necesidades. Son una compañía abierta a sugerencias de formación, recursos y tecnología. No cuentan con restricciones en este aspecto.
Posibilidad de crecimiento profesional, donde estarás acompañado/a por un equipo técnico con ganas de compartir, enseñar y ayudarte a desarrollar todo tu potencial.


¿Cómo será tu proceso de selección?


Aplica a la vacante.
Entrevista estructurada: Si cumples los requisitos, tu Talent Partner se pondrá en contacto contigo para que puedas resolver dudas sobre la posición y para empezar a conocerte más allá de tu CV.
Caso práctico: En caso de que ambas partes consideréis que hay encaje, te enviaremos un caso práctico para que podamos verte en acción👩🏻‍💻.
Entrevista con Ufinet: Si has bordado el caso, agendaremos una entrevista con la compañía para que puedas entrevistar a tus potenciales empleadores y para que ellos puedan entrevistarte a ti.


Durante todo el proceso tendrás contacto directo con tu Talent Agent para poder resolver cualquier duda o inquietud.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Coches.net, Motos.net and Milanuncios.com are among the leading online marketplaces in Spain, connecting millions of buyers and sellers every month. We're looking for an exceptional Data Analyst to help us understand that audience at scale spotting the trends, opportunities and friction points that shape how we improve our products and services.

You'll work as part of a multidisciplinary team, collaborating closely with Product Owners, cluster teams, data engineers and stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product, BizDev and Operations. You'll have real autonomy to define your own analyses, propose new lines of investigation, and see your insights turned into decisions that reach millions of users.

What you'll do


Identify, analyse and interpret KPIs and health metrics related to our users and customers, building dashboards and visualisations to monitor them.
Spot trends, risks and opportunities, and turn them into concrete recommendations to improve the different initiatives across the vertical.
Generate high-impact insights using advanced analytics to deepen our understanding of users and customers.
Actively contribute to the discovery and development of advanced analytical models — such as clustering and predictive models — and their implementation in real business use cases, including customer segmentation and propensity models for upselling, downselling and churn prediction.
Work day-to-day with a modern data stack (including tools like Databricks and Airflow), with room to grow your skills in data engineering and big data as the role evolves.


What we're looking for


3+ years of experience in eCommerce or an online company.
Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis (e.g. pandas, numpy, matplotlib) and analytics (e.g. scikit-learn).
Experience with at least one visualisation tool such as Tableau and/or QlikSense.
Strong analytical skills: comfortable interpreting data, extracting relevant insights, and translating business questions into analytical needs.


Nice to have


Experience working with sales, operations and strategy teams.
Knowledge of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g. clustering, classification, regressions).
Some experience with big data technologies (e.g. Databricks, data lakes).
Some knowledge of data engineering tools (e.g. Airflow, DBT).

Title: Analista de Datos
Description:
¡En Neural buscamos un/a Analista de Datos! 🌟

¿Quiénes somos? 🏢

Nuestra misión es clara: mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas a través de la neurorrehabilitación, el acompañamiento en salud mental y la atención a la infancia con trastornos del neurodesarrollo.

¿Qué buscamos? 🔍

Para seguir creciendo, necesitamos incorporar a una persona que comparta nuestra visión, buscamos un Analista de Datos que transforme datos operativos y de negocio en información accionable. Trabajará junto a equipos de tecnología y negocio para diseñar métricas, construir cuadros de mando y dar soporte a la toma de decisiones.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? 📝


Recopilar, depurar y modelar datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes y plataformas.
Diseñar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes (Power BI / equivalente) para las unidades de negocio.
Analizar tendencias, incidencias y patrones de uso para anticipar problemas de forma proactiva.
Definir y calcular KPIs de servicio (SLA, capacidad, utilización) y de negocio.
Automatizar consultas y procesos repetitivos de reporting mediante SQL y scripting.
Documentar especificaciones de datos y garantizar la calidad e integridad de la información.
Colaborar con Business Analysts, arquitectos y equipos de proyecto para alinear objetivos y entregables.


¿Qué ofrecemos? 📃


Contrato indefinido
Jornada laboral completa y flexible, distribuida de lunes a viernes
Jornada intensiva en julio y agosto
Plan de carrera, formación y desarrollo profesional
Salario a convenir


¿Dónde?📍

Nuestras oficinas centrales se encuentran en Valencia (Polígono Vara de Quart).

¿Te apetece formar parte de nuestro equipo? 🚀

¿Te interesa participar en este proyecto? Si es así y cumples con los requisitos indicados, no dudes en inscribirte a esta oferta de empleo.

Requisitos mínimos


Grado profesional/universitario con 4-6 años de experiencia en analítica de datos o roles equivalentes.
Dominio de SQL y de al menos una herramienta de visualización (Power BI, Tableau o similar).
Experiencia en modelado de datos, ETL y tratamiento de grandes volúmenes de información.
Conocimiento de estadística descriptiva y capacidad de análisis de tendencias.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para traducir datos en recomendaciones de negocio.


Competencias deseables:


Python o R para análisis avanzado y automatización.
Experiencia con plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP) y servicios de datos gestionados.
Conocimiento de gobierno del dato y buenas prácticas de seguridad de la información.

Title: DATA ANALYST - EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Buscamos un Data Analyst para impulsar el desarrollo de la capa informacional del banco y aportar valor directo al negocio y a la dirección. Su misión será transformar datos - estructurados y no estructurados - en conocimiento útil que permita entender mejor el negocio, el mercado y nuestros clientes, así como identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

 

Sus responsabilidades incluyen:

 

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)

Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.
Priorización y planificación de los proyectos y peticiones recurrentes.
Gestión de expectativas, seguimiento y comunicación de resultados.

 

Realización de proyectos en los que se aborda el ciclo completo de análisis de información

Toma de requerimientos de información de negocio
Exploración de datos en Datapool y/o fuentes externas. Desde la búsqueda hasta el tratamiento de los datos hasta generar la información necesaria
Propuesta y generación de KPIs
Construcción de los informes / análisis para presentar la información
Comunicación de resultados a los clientes
Diseño, elaboración, mantenimiento y automatización los procesos para seguimientos recurrentes o peticiones puntuales.

 

Para realizar estas funciones, será necesario:

Tener conocimientos técnicos para llevar a cabo los informes que se requieran desde negocio
Tener cualidades analíticas que permitan entender la lógica de negocio y proponer nuevas ideas o estrategias que ayuden a impulsarlo
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, así como creatividad y atención a los detalles en la visualización y comunicación de información.
Requisitos mínimos
Licenciatura en carreras de ciencias o ingenierías.
Fuertes capacidades de análisis y gestión de datos, con uso de herramientas de análisis y explotación de Bases de datos: alto nivel en SQL, fluidez en Data Discovery y Análisis Estadísticos, Python, GIT, Airflow.
Formación en lenguajes de programación.
Generación de dashboards con herramientas de visualización como QlikSense, Looker, etc.
Nivel avanzado herramientas de ofimática (Excel, Power Point, etc).

 

Se valorará positivamente:

Experiencia trabajando o analizando experiencia de cliente (NPS, touchpoints, etc.)
Experiencia previa en Google Cloud o en otras plataformas cloud (AWS, etc.).
Experiencia previa en Banca en departamentos de analítica/BI.

 

Competencias Clave

 

Gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos
Gestión de proyectos de información (relación con clientes y proveedores)
Capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas
Persona resolutiva, con entusiasmo y compromiso, colaborativa
Perfil flexible, con capacidad de adaptación al cambio
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales
Orientación al negocio y a la experiencia de cliente
Definición y seguimiento de KPI’s comerciales

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Treasury
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Design, build, and maintain robust AI agentic workflows and analytical tools to automate and enhance Treasury data processes and decision-making
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


6+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience working with AI and building agentic workflows
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses
