About Us

devicenow offers Device as a Service for workplace IT hardware on a global scale. We revolutionize the Device as a Service industry – the only thing missing is you!

Your role in the team

Your role in the team is to serve as the link between business departments and the company's data ecosystem, transforming data into reliable insights that support informed decision making.

Act as the bridge between our business departments and our data landscape (databases, data warehouse, Power BI).

Structured, analytical mindset with a sharp eye for inconsistencies in numbers.

Be part of a rapidly expanding industry and take advantage of unique career opportunities.

Flexible hybrid working model – work from home or office, visit our offices around the world.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing


Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.


What You Will Bring To Ogury


Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.


How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:


A competitive compensation package
Comprehensive benefits coverage
Meal voucher
Holiday and leave allowance, in addition to national holidays
A strong focus on the well-being of our team members, with access to both physical and mental health resources
Flexible Working Model: At Ogury, we believe in the power of presence to fuel innovation. Our hybrid approach is centered on two core in-office collaboration days to drive team synergy, plus one additional office day of your choosing to support personal balance. This 3-day baseline ensures strong connection and real-time problem-solving, while allowing for flexibility across the rest of the week.
And more


We thank you in advance for your interest in Ogury!

Title: Senior Data Analyst - B2B
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

This role is embedded within either the B2B domain and is part of Preply’s Data Chapter. You will work closely with directors, B2B leaders, and cross-functional partners across finance and product teams, while collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers to strengthen analytical foundations and business impact.

What you’ll be doing:


Partner with senior stakeholders across Business and Operations to proactively identify where new analyses, metrics, or frameworks can unlock improvements in retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.
Build and own the analytical framework leadership uses to evaluate B2B trade-offs, and define the long-term measurement framework that identifies structural growth levers, not just incremental wins.
Lead high-complexity, end-to-end analytical initiatives — including retention and cohort analyses that answer specific open questions from B2B leadership — uncovering root causes behind revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, and cost efficiency, and turning findings into concrete pricing, product, or lifecycle recommendations.
Own impact modeling, scenario analysis, and KPI governance for B2B: resolve conflicting metric definitions across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Product, maintain a single source of truth, and feed directly into quarterly and annual planning.
Design the experimentation and analytics agenda, what gets tested, how success is measured, and translate results into executive-ready storytelling that aligns stakeholders on goals and trade-offs.
Partner with Directors and VPs to shape B2B strategy, embed analytics into daily decision-making, and mentor senior analysts to raise the analytical bar.


What you need to succeed:


5+ years of experience in analytics roles (ideally in B2B), with demonstrated ownership of KPI frameworks and measurable impact on retention, revenue, or efficiency.
You can point to specific decisions (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and one where your recommendation was rejected, with the judgment to explain why, in hindsight, that was right or wrong.
You've owned a metric or strategic framework other teams were required to use, and resolved a conflict between two teams who each wanted a different definition to win.
Deep understanding of retention and performance metrics (revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, cost efficiency), and the ability to build an LTV or cohort model from scratch, not just interpret one someone else built.
Strong, independent SQL, you're the person other analysts send their code to for review; proven ability to lead cross-functional analytical projects end-to-end.
Strong business acumen and stakeholder influence: comfortable saying no to a request that wasn't the right question, clarifying trade-offs in metrics and resourcing, and building forecast or scenario models that leadership uses to defend a bet to their own leadership.


Nice to have:


Background in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or account-based business models; exposure to customer support operations.
Experience building or scaling an analytics function (hiring, tooling, process, KPI frameworks).
Hands-on experience with Looker, Snowflake, Tableau, or Power BI.
Working knowledge of Python for analysis.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.


Why you’ll love it at Preply:


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

Title: Corporate Data Analyst
Description:
¿Y si el futuro de las decisiones de un gigante del retail dependiera de los datos que tú transformas?

Si lo que más valoras es...


Aprendizaje continuo: Sumergirte de lleno en arquitecturas cloud de vanguardia y metodologías que impulsan la transformación digital en un entorno multinacional.
Trabajo en equipo: Colaborar codo con codo con equipos de negocio y Business Analysts, convirtiéndote en su referente estratégico.
Estabilidad y crecimiento: Desarrollar tu carrera profesional dentro del grupo ADEO con la seguridad que brinda un líder indiscutible del sector.
Cultura humana: Formar parte de un ambiente donde las personas son el centro, apoyado en la confianza, el respeto y el bienestar integral.


Este reto es para ti si...


Cuentas con al menos 3 años de experiencia como Data Analyst o en roles analíticos/BI de impacto.
Dominas SQL avanzado (especialmente BigQuery) y te apasiona crear soluciones de visualización impactantes en Looker, Power BI o Looker Studio.
Tienes formación universitaria (Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Economía o similar) y sólida experiencia navegando por Cloud Data Warehouses y Datalakes.
Cuentas con un nivel de inglés B2 consolidado (capaz de comunicarte eficazmente con equipos internacionales).
Te caracteriza tu visión de negocio, capacidad analítica y habilidad para traducir necesidades analíticas en soluciones claras y funcionales.


Qué harás...

Tu misión principal será impulsar el uso estratégico de los datos en la compañía, garantizando su trazabilidad, homogeneidad y máxima calidad.


Estrategia y Gobierno del Dato: Implementarás el marco de datos corporativo garantizando el concepto de golden record (evitando duplicidades) y fomentando la cultura del autoservicio analítico en toda la organización.
Generación de Insights de Impacto: Acompañarás a distintas áreas para transformar datos en conocimiento valioso, industrializando análisis recurrentes e identificando ventajas competitivas mediante el uso de analítica avanzada.
Desarrollo de Soluciones Analíticas: Inspeccionarás, limpiarás, modelarás datos y construirás dashboards y reportes corporativos para optimizar la toma de decisiones.
Proyección Internacional: Asegurarás el diseño de soluciones que integren los nuevos proyectos del negocio, extendiendo tus iniciativas a servicios compartidos dentro del Grupo ADEO.


Lo que ofrecemos...


Un Onboarding de Impacto: Disfrutarás de una inmersión profunda en la estrategia global del área de datos para conocer de cerca a tus interlocutores clave y la arquitectura del ecosistema.
Desarrollo a la Carta: Tendrás acceso continuo a formación especializada, certificaciones cloud y planes de carrera diseñados a la medida de tus ambiciones.
Flexibilidad y Conciliación: Ofrecemos un modelo de trabajo híbrido con 2 días de teletrabajo a la semana y horarios flexibles para que organices tu tiempo a tu manera.
Beneficios de Bienestar: Cuidamos de ti con seguro de salud privado completo y acceso a programas integrales de salud física y mental.
Accionariado y Retribución Flexible: Opción de formar parte de nuestro sistema interno de accionariado del grupo y catálogo de ventajas fiscales para tu retribución.


Queremos conocerte y ver cómo juntos podemos llevar la analítica de datos al siguiente nivel. ¡Aplica ahora y da el siguiente salto en tu carrera profesional!

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Un/a Analista de Power BI que quiera unirse al equipo de uno de nuestros clientes del sector financiero, con proyección internacional y entorno de trabajo francófono.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At LittleBig Connection, we firmly believe in the transformative power of data analytics and AI to enhance business operations, drive informed decision-making and foster sustainable business growth.

To reinforce our young and ambitious Data and AI team we are seeking an experienced Data Analyst. You will own the semantic layer of our data platform: the models, metrics and definitions that the whole company relies on. Beyond reporting, you will be expected to explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next and what should be done about it. You will collaborate closely with key business stakeholders (Financial Partners, Head of Business, Product Managers) to develop impactful analytics solutions.




Key Responsibilities:




Design, build and maintain the semantic model of the platform with dbt: staging, marts, metrics, tests and documentation.
Own the definition of business metrics and make sure they are consistent, documented and unique across all consumption surfaces.
Contribute to data governance: ownership, naming conventions, data contracts, catalog and quality standards on the analytics layer.
Run diagnostic analyses: identify root causes behind business variations rather than only reporting them.
Build predictive analyses (forecasting, scoring, propensity) to anticipate business and product trends.
Turn those insights into prescriptive recommendations: scenarios, simulations and actionable next steps for stakeholders.
Deliver reporting and visualizations where they are the right answer, on top of the semantic model rather than beside it.
Collaborate with the data engineering team on pipelines and modelling, and act as a referent on analytics practices within the team.




Ideal profile:




Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, IT, or related field
At least 3 years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or related fields
Advanced SQL, and hands-on production experience with dbt
Strong background in data modelling: dimensional modelling, semantic layers, metric definitions
Comfortable with Python for statistical and predictive work
Experience with data governance practices (documentation, ownership, data quality)
Working knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, preferably Azure Databricks, and of a visualization tool (e.g. Microsoft Power BI)
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving aptitude, and a high standard of rigor and precision
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
Proactive and entrepreneurial, you are embracing challenges with enthusiasm
Fluent in English, both written and spoken




If you are interested in working in a fast growing company, on unique and innovative projects where you can use your creativity, this opportunity is tailored for you!




What We Offer




Grow your career in the new world of digital business.
Lead high-value strategic projects with a tangible business impact.
Work in a young, international, and multicultural environment, with teams across five continents.
Enjoy a flexible working environment, including hybrid work options.
Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities to continuously grow your skills.
Take part in the LittleBig Crew experience through afterworks, team-building activities, and internal and external events.




Diversity & Inclusion




LittleBig Connection is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within our teams and fostering an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, religion, age, marital status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.




Who are we?




The world of work is changing faster than ever. Companies need increasingly specialized expertise, while freelancers, consulting firms, and niche experts are reshaping the way organizations collaborate.




At LittleBig Connection, part of Mantu, our mission is simple: to create a direct, transparent, and efficient link between large organizations and the external experts who help them deliver their most important projects.




Through our international marketplace, we enable companies to quickly access the expertise they need, wherever they are. We help them identify, select, and contract with external experts while ensuring simplicity, compliance, and security throughout the process.




Today, LittleBig Connection brings together more than 400 employees across 50 countries, operates through 12 international offices, and facilitates over €500 million worth of projects every year through its platform.




Thousands of professionals from leading organizations rely on LittleBig Connection to collaborate with freelancers, consulting firms, and specialized experts around the world.




Joining LittleBig Connection means helping shape a new way for companies and experts to work together. It also means growing within an international, entrepreneurial, and fast-moving environment where ownership, accountability, transparency, and teamwork are part of everyday life.




At LittleBig Connection, everyone is encouraged to take initiative, create tangible impact, and contribute to a shared ambition: connecting the best expertise with the projects that matter most.




Team up with the world.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;


At BESTSECRET, diversity isn't just a trend – it's our professional philosophy. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace where everyone's unique talents and backgrounds are celebrated. Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

  • En colaboración con los equipos de Inventario y Pricing crear dashboards e informes automatizados de revenue en herramientas como Microstrategy y Excel.
  • Monitorear y analizar indicadores clave de desempeño como tasa de ocupación, pickup y pace. Proponer y ejecutar acciones sobre de venta de acuerdo a los indicadores analizados.
  • En coordinación con otros departamentos implementar estrategias de precios dinámicos basadas en demanda, datos históricos y competencia.
  • Forecasting: Análisis de datos históricos y tendencias para proyectar ventas.
  • Análisis de resultados (recomendaciones acciones correctivas si aplican).
  • Tareas variadas: Control competencia (precios/ocupaciones) manejos MLOS, control cupos y dimensionar ventas por mercado/canal.

  • Habilidades organizativas y atención al detalle tanto en la precisión del dato como en la estética visual de las entregas.
  • Comunicación oral y escrita.
  • Gestión del tiempo y de proyectos.
  • Buenas habilidades numéricas y capacidad analítica.

Title: Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience with the following would be a plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What we can offer you


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Summary



ABOUT US



We are an international pharmaceutical company committed to the veterinary profession, with a constantly growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products and diets. Our focus is on veterinarians, whom we approach with compelling solutions designed to make us their trusted partner.

Dechra is one of the fastest-growing and most consistently successful global veterinary companies. Our size enables us to maintain a personal approach, remain flexible and respond quickly to change, allowing us to make decisions with agility.

At the same time, we are a strong and well-established company, with the product portfolio and technical capabilities needed to provide our customers with the support they need.

OUR PEOPLE

Are solution oriented and pro-active
Love working together
Have a 'can do' mentality
Are easy to approach
Value honesty
Are professional
Are able to punch above their weight
Have the desire to win
Have fun

YOU WILL FIT IN

If you have strong analytic and problem-solving skills
If you are able to understand the business and deliver based on a strong commercial focus
If you are self-motivated and highly organized
If you are responsive and flexible to change
If you are cooperative and have the desire to make a difference together
If you are structured and independent

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a key role at Dechra in Iberia as the company is growing fast and data analysis is gaining importance to support business decisions and improvements.

The Data Analyst is ultimately responsible for making available and clear all data necessary to contribute to translate the strategy and plans into clear reports by using relevant data. The tasks and responsabilities include:

Analysis of sell in and sell out data across all the business areas.
Management of the source master data (customer and product) ensuring the reliability and veracity of data.
Validating development requests from the business allowingreports improvement and upgrades.
Management of the CRM data and reports (maintenance and update).
Preparation of periodic and ad hoc reports to analyse comercial stategies.
Collection and consolidation of data from different sources (mainly Excel and SQL Server).
Process documentation.
Involvement in budgeting and forecasting process.
Evaluation and process of the data to facilitate the decision taking from sales, marketing and business managers.
Develop strong internal relationship with the sales team to understand the market and support them.
Ensure the connection between CRM and marketing.
Providing user support services to ensure problems are remediated quickly and effectively.
Providing training (Targit, Salesforce, BI software) for new users and new functionality for existing users.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

This job might be for you when you have:

A higher education or degree within the area of Computer science, Economics, Finance, or related bachelor degree.
Experience of Business Intelligence systems.
Ideally a minimum of 2/3 years' experience in a similar position.
Basic programming skills for data manipulation.
Ability to develop key and beneficial relationships with stakeholders.
Excellent commercial networking approach to enable the growth of the business.
Ability to structure and organize effectively and deliver to tight deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
Natural leadership skills to lead high performing teams.
High level of Excel use.
Knowlegde of SQL/Power BI/Targit/ Salesforce.
Ideally based in Barcelona.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Spanish Fluent (verbal and written)

English Fluent English

Title: Experienced Data Analyst - Digital Sales (m/f/d)
Description:
Your Tasks

This position is part of the Digital Sales Data Foundation team, which drives data-driven decision making across our digital platforms by analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and measuring the impact of strategic initiatives with a strong focus on A/B testing to enhance customer experience and business performance. You will work closely with other Data Analysts, Data Engineers, a dedicated Product Owner, and colleagues from global and local business departments.

Your tasks:


Partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve analytics, tracking, and experimentation initiatives across digital areas.

Title: Senior Digital Data Analyst (Marketing Intelligence)
Description:
Desde Timup, consultora de selección, estamos colaborando con una agencia creativa en la búsqueda de un/a Senior Marketing Analytics Specialist, una posición con recorrido hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Buscamos una persona que combine una sólida capacidad analítica con una visión estratégica del marketing y la comunicación. Alguien capaz de transformar datos en recomendaciones de negocio, ayudar a medir el impacto real de las campañas y convertirse en un partner de referencia tanto para clientes como para los equipos internos.

La persona incorporada tendrá un papel clave impulsando una cultura data-driven dentro de la organización, liderando proyectos de medición y contribuyendo a maximizar la efectividad de las estrategias de comunicación.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Serás responsable de analizar el rendimiento de campañas y acciones de comunicación, tanto digitales como offline, convirtiendo los datos en insights que permitan tomar mejores decisiones de negocio. Además, liderarás la interlocución con clientes en todo lo relacionado con analítica y medición, participando activamente en la evolución del área.




Responsabilidades

Analizar el rendimiento de campañas de comunicación y marketing, evaluando su impacto sobre la marca y el negocio.

Diseñar, desarrollar e interpretar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para clientes y equipos internos.

Liderar la relación con clientes en materia de analítica, reporting y medición de resultados.

Integrar información procedente de diferentes fuentes para obtener una visión global del rendimiento de las acciones de marketing.

Colaborar estrechamente con equipos multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades de optimización.

Impulsar el uso del análisis de datos como herramienta para mejorar la efectividad de las campañas y la toma de decisiones.

Participar en la evolución de metodologías y procesos de medición dentro de la compañía.




¿Qué buscamos?

Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics o Performance Analytics.

Experiencia previa en agencia o en entornos digitales de ritmo dinámico.

Dominio de herramientas de visualización de datos como Tableau (muy valorable), Power BI, Looker o Qlik.

Conocimientos sólidos de marketing digital, comunicación y medición de campañas.

Experiencia trabajando con SQL, análisis de datos y estadística aplicada.

Capacidad para sintetizar grandes volúmenes de información y convertirlos en recomendaciones accionables.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación de resultados.

Nivel alto de inglés (C1).




Se valorará especialmente

Conocimientos de Python.

Experiencia con herramientas como Adverity, Supermetrics o Datorama.

Conocimientos de Social Listening (Brandwatch, Lumen/Talkwalker, Pulsar, entre otras).

Uso de herramientas de IA como Claude, Gemini o NotebookLM aplicadas al análisis de datos y automatización de procesos.




¿Qué ofrece la compañía?

Incorporación a una agencia creativa reconocida, con un entorno altamente colaborativo e innovador.

Posición con recorrido profesional y posibilidad de evolucionar hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

Horario flexible y jornada intensiva durante el verano.

Plan de retribución flexible.

Acceso a formación continua y desarrollo profesional.

Programas de bienestar y beneficios sociales.

Participación en un entorno donde los datos tienen un papel estratégico en la toma de decisiones y el crecimiento de los clientes.

Title: DATA ANALYST - EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Buscamos un Data Analyst para impulsar el desarrollo de la capa informacional del banco y aportar valor directo al negocio y a la dirección. Su misión será transformar datos - estructurados y no estructurados - en conocimiento útil que permita entender mejor el negocio, el mercado y nuestros clientes, así como identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

 

Sus responsabilidades incluyen:

 

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)

Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Coches.net, Motos.net and Milanuncios.com are among the leading online marketplaces in Spain, connecting millions of buyers and sellers every month. We're looking for an exceptional Data Analyst to help us understand that audience at scale spotting the trends, opportunities and friction points that shape how we improve our products and services.

You'll work as part of a multidisciplinary team, collaborating closely with Product Owners, cluster teams, data engineers and stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product, BizDev and Operations. You'll have real autonomy to define your own analyses, propose new lines of investigation, and see your insights turned into decisions that reach millions of users.

What you'll do


Identify, analyse and interpret KPIs and health metrics related to our users and customers, building dashboards and visualisations to monitor them.
Spot trends, risks and opportunities, and turn them into concrete recommendations to improve the different initiatives across the vertical.
Generate high-impact insights using advanced analytics to deepen our understanding of users and customers.
Actively contribute to the discovery and development of advanced analytical models — such as clustering and predictive models — and their implementation in real business use cases, including customer segmentation and propensity models for upselling, downselling and churn prediction.
Work day-to-day with a modern data stack (including tools like Databricks and Airflow), with room to grow your skills in data engineering and big data as the role evolves.


What we're looking for


3+ years of experience in eCommerce or an online company.
Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis (e.g. pandas, numpy, matplotlib) and analytics (e.g. scikit-learn).
Experience with at least one visualisation tool such as Tableau and/or QlikSense.
Strong analytical skills: comfortable interpreting data, extracting relevant insights, and translating business questions into analytical needs.


Nice to have


Experience working with sales, operations and strategy teams.
Knowledge of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g. clustering, classification, regressions).
Some experience with big data technologies (e.g. Databricks, data lakes).
Some knowledge of data engineering tools (e.g. Airflow, DBT).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing


Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.


What You Will Bring To Ogury


Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.


How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:


A competitive compensation package
Comprehensive benefits coverage
Meal voucher
Holiday and leave allowance, in addition to national holidays
A strong focus on the well-being of our team members, with access to both physical and mental health resources
Flexible Working Model: At Ogury, we believe in the power of presence to fuel innovation. Our hybrid approach is centered on two core in-office collaboration days to drive team synergy, plus one additional office day of your choosing to support personal balance. This 3-day baseline ensures strong connection and real-time problem-solving, while allowing for flexibility across the rest of the week.
And more


We thank you in advance for your interest in Ogury!

Our Commitment

At Ogury, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace by providing equal employment opportunities to all. We will consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive candidate experience. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us. In accordance with applicable laws, we will work with you to provide reasonable support and ensure a fair hiring process.

Please note that this position is for an existing vacancy and is open to all qualified candidates.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Senior Data Analyst - Treasury
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Design, build, and maintain robust AI agentic workflows and analytical tools to automate and enhance Treasury data processes and decision-making
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


6+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience working with AI and building agentic workflows
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.

Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.

AI Transparency Statement

Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Summary



ABOUT US



We are an international pharmaceutical company committed to the veterinary profession, with a constantly growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products and diets. Our focus is on veterinarians, whom we approach with compelling solutions designed to make us their trusted partner.

Dechra is one of the fastest-growing and most consistently successful global veterinary companies. Our size enables us to maintain a personal approach, remain flexible and respond quickly to change, allowing us to make decisions with agility.

At the same time, we are a strong and well-established company, with the product portfolio and technical capabilities needed to provide our customers with the support they need.

OUR PEOPLE

Are solution oriented and pro-active
Love working together
Have a 'can do' mentality
Are easy to approach
Value honesty
Are professional
Are able to punch above their weight
Have the desire to win
Have fun

YOU WILL FIT IN

If you have strong analytic and problem-solving skills
If you are able to understand the business and deliver based on a strong commercial focus
If you are self-motivated and highly organized
If you are responsive and flexible to change
If you are cooperative and have the desire to make a difference together
If you are structured and independent

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a key role at Dechra in Iberia as the company is growing fast and data analysis is gaining importance to support business decisions and improvements.

The Data Analyst is ultimately responsible for making available and clear all data necessary to contribute to translate the strategy and plans into clear reports by using relevant data. The tasks and responsabilities include:

Analysis of sell in and sell out data across all the business areas.
Management of the source master data (customer and product) ensuring the reliability and veracity of data.
Validating development requests from the business allowingreports improvement and upgrades.
Management of the CRM data and reports (maintenance and update).
Preparation of periodic and ad hoc reports to analyse comercial stategies.
Collection and consolidation of data from different sources (mainly Excel and SQL Server).
Process documentation.
Involvement in budgeting and forecasting process.
Evaluation and process of the data to facilitate the decision taking from sales, marketing and business managers.
Develop strong internal relationship with the sales team to understand the market and support them.
Ensure the connection between CRM and marketing.
Providing user support services to ensure problems are remediated quickly and effectively.
Providing training (Targit, Salesforce, BI software) for new users and new functionality for existing users.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

This job might be for you when you have:

A higher education or degree within the area of Computer science, Economics, Finance, or related bachelor degree.
Experience of Business Intelligence systems.
Ideally a minimum of 2/3 years' experience in a similar position.
Basic programming skills for data manipulation.
Ability to develop key and beneficial relationships with stakeholders.
Excellent commercial networking approach to enable the growth of the business.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;


At BESTSECRET, diversity isn't just a trend – it's our professional philosophy. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace where everyone's unique talents and backgrounds are celebrated. Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

Conetic is an innovative global company dedicated to transforming the flying experience by making the passenger journey engaging and truly memorable.

We specialize in comprehensive media services, with a focus on creating more personalized and engaging experiences for travelers at every step of the journey.

By uniting Touch Inflight Solutions and ABOVE, Conetic brings together a leading IFE content service provider and a robust cloud-based media distribution platform. This combination of curated content, data-driven personalization, and an automated cloud media supply chain enables airlines to deliver fresh, personalized content to passengers faster and more efficiently through a seamless, end-to-end solution.

As our Data Analyst, you will provide essential support to the Digital Products & Innovation department by performing a variety of data analysis tasks, such as organizing large amounts of data, defining trends and patterns, as well as supporting data architects on other projects.

Conduct complex data analysis and report on results;
Interpret trends and patterns
Evaluate business needs and objectives
Analyze and organize raw information from different sources
Build data systems, pipelines, algorithms and prototypes
Develop analytical tools and programs
Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability
Prepare data for prescriptive and predictive modeling
Identify opportunities for data acquisition
Collaborate with data scientists and architects on several projects

Strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems with data.

Comfortable working with large datasets and integrating data from multiple sources.
Skilled in using statistical techniques and data modeling to uncover insights.

International team;

Description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That's the future we're building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don't just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.
