Title: Data Scientist - Marketing Analytics
Description:
Do you want to be part of the change?

Then, you’re in the right place. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future for our clients and our teams… But we can’t do that without you!

By joining BNP Paribas Personal Finance, take part in our great transformation towards building a more sustainable world: we are committed to promoting access to more responsible and sustainable consumption to support our customers and partners.

To achieve this, we implement concrete actions, not only in the way we develop our business and enhance our sustainable growth, with the ambition to reduce our environmental footprint, but also in the way we support those who need it most.

Our analytical teams use state-of-the-art data science and visualization techniques to solve business issues and uncover opportunities for BNP Paribas Person Finance. Our team is embedded in the business context, and we ensure that we deliver fast, stable, and scalable data and AI solutions with a measurable impact for our stakeholders. We have vast amounts of data in the Bank, and we know that the value will come with robust solutions deployed in production.

In practice, your day-to-day

About

Integrated in the Marketing, B2C & B2B scope, the Data Scientist will collect information about customer behavior. You will mainly use Python, SAS and SQL tools to:


Develop, maintain and validate data workflows, guaranteeing the quality of our data assets
Design, create and adapt statistical/ML/AI predictive and decisional models - mainly classifiers, scores, segmentations, churn models, time series analyses.
Deploy the solutions or execute them in batch and validate their metrics during implementation, such as in relational marketing.
Brief stakeholders on the setup, gains and possible evolution of your solutions, and align with offer, relational, communication and business on optimizing our value proposition.
Create one-off analyses and prototypes, design and run test&learn experiments to develop new business and marketing strategies.
Interact with IT, data, operational, and financial teams to ensure data flows, process integration, and standardized analyses and pipelines.
Ensure high quality delivery, in both data extractions, data quality checks, run performance, and code quality.


The Mission is important, but so is the Team and the workplace!

Welcome to BNP Paribas Personal Finance, where you will integrate the Marketing Analytics team, composed of specialized, innovative and team-spirited individuals, and based in Lisbon and Porto.

We will accommodate you with an initial integration plan, on-the-job learning, training resources, and networking opportunities.

What do we have to offer you?

This is a very important topic that we’ll discuss together, based on your specific experience and education.

For Now, We Highlight The Following Benefits


Flexible Benefits Platform (benefit+): package that considers benefits in areas such as protection, education and well-being, and which always includes Health Insurance, extendable to your family, and Life Insurance
Extra vacation days, up to 31, depending on seniority and volunteering
Partnerships with thousands of entities that give access to some advantages (tourism, food, hospitality, fashion, technology...
Personal Credit to employees, under advantageous conditions compared to the market
Smart working policy
24-hour helpline available in case you need psychological, legal, financial/tax and psychosocial support


Are you the one we are looking for?


Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or related field
Strong programming and scripting skills in Python
Quantitative analysis skills and applied knowledge about machine learning, statistical analysis (AB testing, significance tests, uplift models), churn models, optimization?
Good knowledge of data workflows: SQL and ETL processes
Proficiency in git
Good communication and organization skills, initiative, focus on delivery
Good level of English
Optional: previous experience in a financial or technological or research environment, knowledge of SAS (or ability to become proficient in PROC SQL and macros), working in agile mode, CI/CD processes


If you have all this, motivation, energy and a good mood, then you are the one we are seeking...

We look forward to your application!

Our commitments

BNP Paribas Personal Finance is an equal opportunity employer that is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all job seekers. As a socially responsible company, we incorporate the principles of Diversity and Inclusion in our values and practices.

Title: ME Systems - Manufacturing Data Scientist

ME Systems - Manufacturing Data Scientist

Versigent designs and delivers the systems that move power through modern technology. From vehicles to robotics to energy platforms, our electrical distribution systems enable the next generation of electrified, automated and connected products.

As a standalone company, we combine deep engineering expertise with the speed and focus needed to solve increasingly complex challenges. Our teams move quickly, think with precision and deliver at scale — helping customers do more without adding cost, weight or complexity.

What defines us is how we work: with the agility and momentum of a startup, backed by the experience and discipline of a proven global leader. That combination creates an environment where ideas move faster, ownership is real and impact is visible.

YOUR ROLE

As a Data Scientist, you will perform Data Analysis for various Manufacturing Engineering Processes, such as Ultrasonic welding, Torque machines, ROB, Crimping or any other processes designated by the company. Find insights and patterns hidden inside the data and proactively engage with management and team to explore the findings and drive organizational value .

Responsibilities

Design & Architecture


Analyze historical data to identify patterns, trends, and insights and compare Statistical Process Control (SPC)
Preprocess and clean data for machine learning applications
Create effective feature engineering pipelines for time series data
Validate data quality and handle missing or anomalous data
Visualize data and results to communicate findings effectively


Algorithm Development and Implementation


Apply statistical and mathematical approaches to time series analysis and forecasting
Implement and optimize machine learning algorithms using Python and relevant frameworks
Realize benchmark on model performance
Document methodologies, experiments, and results


Collaboration and Deployment


Proactively engage with management and team to explore the findings and drive organizational value
Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions
Communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Contribute to team discussions and planning sessions


Learning & Development


Stay aware of latest developments in data science, machine learning
Experiment with new techniques and frameworks under guidance
Participate in internal training and skill development activities
Document learnings and sharing knowledge with the team
Gradually expand expertise across different ML domains, like Causal ML


YOUR BACKGROUND


0-2years in a relevant project
Experience in Machine Learning Fundamentals and Data visualization techniques
Intermediate knowledge in Scikit-Learn, Streamlit, Seaborn, Numpy, Pandas, SQL, Plotly and StatsModel and Python
Experience collaborating with stakeholders in dynamic, cross-functional environments


Qualifications


Master’s degree (preferred) in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Technology, Engineering.
Intermediate experience in Data Analysis
Advanced knowledge in mathematics and Statistics
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


WHY JOIN US?


Grow with purpose. We invest in our people by creating opportunities to build skills, take on new challenges, and develop over time.
Do work that shows up in the real world. What you contribute here powers systems that are critical to how industries operate and evolve. The impact is visible and lasting.
Succeed with the right support. We provide the tools, resources, and environment needed to perform at a high level and sustain that success.

Private health care effective day 1 of employment
Learning and development opportunities
Opportunities to give back to the community

Valid residence permit or working visa
Portuguese Tax Identification Number (NIF)
Portuguese Social Security Number (NISS)

Title: Demand Planning Analyst
Description:
About Vantiva

Pushing the Edge

Vantiva (Euronext Paris: VANTI) is a global technology leader in connectivity technologies. For over 130 years, we have delivered solutions that connect what matters most. Today, we continue to redefine connectivity with industry-leading broadband, video, and IoT-driven smart systems that elevate how people live, work, and connect globally.

Vantiva combines a customer-focused approach with decades of software development, electronics hardware design, and flexible supply chain expertise to deliver high-quality solutions at scale. This proficiency has positioned us as a trusted provider to leading network service providers, enterprise customers, and consumers around the world.

Our strong commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices has earned us multiple Gold and Platinum Medals from EcoVadis for environmental and social performance. These awards place us among the top 2% of organizations in our category evaluated globally.

With our headquarters in Paris and major offices in Australia, Brazil, China, India, South Korea, the United Kingdom, and the United States, we serve a diverse global customer base.

For more information, please visit vantiva.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X (Twitter).

Job Description

As part of the Vantiva Connected Home Global Supply Chain Operations department, we are looking for a Demand Planning Analyst who enjoys working in a challenging, ever-changing environment and who enjoys rolling up their sleeves to get the job done. A self-motivated individual who is proficient in collaborating with Business Operations and other stakeholders to deliver quality, high-accuracy data and reporting, drive tasks to completion on time, and support strategic priorities with a focus on team success.

Key Responsibilities


Support the S&OP process with Business Operations to establish consensus forecasts (including monthly turnover and what-if analysis)
Analyze variations of multiple data such as sales, consensus, constrained, and management forecasts, sales order coverage. Propose the best scenario to drive the supply chain accordingly on weekly basis following the S&OP deadlines.
Proposes weekly requirements (GOP) to meet consensus forecasts in budgets.
Demand management (shipping request) as a key input for the back office to be used with our manufacturing partners such as ODM, OEM, etc.
Master Data Management, Improved Automation of Supply Chain Tools
Support for product lifecycle management from NPI to end-of-life, risk reduction.
Monitor and control inventory levels
Support buffer stock programs (finished goods, ...)
Generate key business outcomes around customer intimacy (internal and external), understanding market trends, and products.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (like NPI/SFT/Bus.Ops/CSR/Logistics/Finance) to ensure accurate exchange of business data (like quantity/revenue at planning horizon) during the products lifecycle.


Skills


Master’s or bachelor’s degree in operations and supply chain management, Business Planning or +5 years of professional experience as a Demand Planning Analyst
Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and develop insights into complex business data (from collection, analysis to outcome)
Attention to detail and a keen sense of urgency and deadlines
A good command of Microsoft Office tools is required (PowerBI, PowerAutomate, Excel, AI etc.)
Kinaxis Rapid Response knowledge is required
SAP skills are not mandatory but are preferable
Apics CPIM or CSCP certifications are an advantage as well as an understanding of Lean principles
Comfortable in a remote and international teamwork environment; Self-motivated and results-oriented
Strong organizational skills, strong communication and presentation skills, and ability to influence internal direction
Language(s): English required; French and Spanish are an advantage


Location


Portugal - Lisbon

Title: Data & Insights Engineer, Customer Solutions
Description:
About Daltix

Daltix helps leading FMCG and retail companies make better decisions using reliable, accessible and carefully curated product data.

Every day, we collect, standardize and deliver large-scale data on prices, promotions, products and assortments. Our customers—including companies such as Colruyt Group, YouGov and Danone—use this information to understand their markets, monitor competitors and identify commercial opportunities.

Data quality is central to what we do. We remove the complexity of collecting and preparing retail data so our customers can focus on using it.

About The Role

We are hiring a Data & Insights Engineer – Customer Solutions for a hands-on, customer-facing role bridging data engineering and analytics. You will build data pipelines and models, analyze large-scale retail datasets, and work directly with customers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.

Collaborating with our engineering, data science, and product teams, this role is ideal for someone who excels at both solving technical problems and communicating findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Your time will typically be divided between (indicative percentages—may vary by customer project):


50% Data Engineering: Building and maintaining pipelines, models and customer datasets
25% Analysis & Insight Delivery: Exploring data and producing reports, dashboards and recommendations
20% Product & Commercial Support: Identifying reusable solutions and contributing to project scoping
5% Customer Collaboration: Participate in workshops, defining requirements and supporting customers



What You’ll Do

Data Engineering & Reliability


Pipelines & Models: Design, build, and maintain SQL/Python ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and customer-facing datasets.
Retail Data: Process large-scale product, price, and promotion data.
Quality & Ops: Ensure data accuracy, monitor pipelines/dashboards, resolve failures, and improve system scalability.



Analytics & Insights


Solutions: Create reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using Daltix tools.
Communication: Present clear insights to both technical and business audiences.



Customer Engagement


Requirements: Run customer workshops, translate business needs into technical deliverables, and iterate on feedback.
Support: Drive product adoption, assist users, and resolve data/reporting inquiries.



Tech Tools (Our tech stack evolves—you are not expected to know every tool before joining)


Hardware & OS: MacBook or Framework running Linux
Data & Storage: SQL, Snowflake, PostgreSQL
Code: Python, uv, Pandas
Orchestration & Infra: Apache Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes
Internal Tools & Ops: Retool, Git, Jira
Collaboration & AI: Google Workspace, Slack, modern AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude)



How we work


Team & Structure: Join a 4-person team reporting to the Head of Product Delivery, collaborating closely with Data/Platform Engineering, Data Science, and Product Delivery.
Autonomy & Support: Take ownership of work backed by pairing, code reviews, mentoring, and clear documentation.
Slack Availability: Active on Slack UTC 08:30–15:00 (includes a flexible 1-hour lunch break).
On-Call & Monitoring: Monitor customer deliverables on a rotational basis during normal working hours only (no out-of-hours on-call).



What We’re Looking For

Strong fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills, and a desire to learn matter more than knowing every tool in our stack.

Requirements

Core Tech: Strong SQL (relational/analytical DBs) and practical Python (e.g., Pandas).

Data Engineering: solid understanding of ETL/ELT, data warehousing, data modeling, and handling large datasets.

Workflows & Mindset: Git/collaborative workflows, strong analytical problem-solving, and ability to turn business questions into technical deliverables.

Communication & Education: Professional English, confidence with customers/non-technical stakeholders, and a relevant degree (e.g., CS, Business Engineering, Applied Economics) or equivalent experience.

Domain Interest: Eagerness to learn FMCG, retail, and pricing analytics.

Location & Travel: Remote (Europe) or Lisbon-based, requiring :4 short trips per year (1 to Benelux clients, 3 to Lisbon engineering team) with travel and accommodation expenses fully covered by Daltix.

Nice to have (but not a requirement)

Stack & Tools: Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Airflow, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Retool), and notebook environments (Jupyter, Marimo).

Specialized Tech: Data matching, entity resolution, and AI coding/analysis tools.

Domain & Delivery: FMCG/retail/pricing experience, customer-facing consulting, or project delivery.

Languages: Dutch or German.

Title: Data Engineer (Databricks)
Description:
Do you want to be part of a company that specializes 100% in its own #Data & #Analytics projects? If so, keep reading! 👀

Even though we are relatively unknown to the general public, at SDG we work for half of the IBEX-35 groups and other international companies. Thanks to the analytics boom, we are growing steadily and have been helping our clients understand and analyse their data since 1994.




What makes us different? 🧐

In our projects, data and technology are the leaders, we will train you to be able to work with the latest in the market (we have an innovation area where we promote new partnerships with technology manufacturers and R&D centers).
You will have all the opportunities to develop your best self, with a completely customized career plan in which you will learn on your own and also have the support of your colleagues. You will set your own time, you will talk to your manager every six months to share feedback and new challenges, and based on your results, there will be a salary review.
We are a big family, from the first moment we will try to make your life easier. Your colleagues and the rest of the team will always have a smile on their faces and will be ready to help and support you.
You will collaborate and work on a daily basis with great references (technical and/or business), they will be happy to teach you as much as possible and will be proud to see you grow.
Smartwork is possible with us. You will experience a way of working where everyone manages their own time.
We are a brand with purpose. We believe that diversity and inclusion help promote a culture of creativity, allowing us to overcome new situations and challenges as an organization committed to people and society.
Getting into more formal matters, but not less important, we offer a permanent contract, we want you to stay with us for a long time! A competitive salary according to your level of training and experience (don't worry, we will discuss this aspect in the first interview and inform you if your expectations are aligned).




We could go on and on about what makes us special, and we'd love to do it in a phone call. For now, let's show you some details that we're sure you'll find interesting 👇🏼







What will be your mission? ✍

Analysis, design and development of solutions and projects in the field of data engineering in Business Intelligence.
Data processing and development of ETL processes.
Creation and modeling of Data Marts in relational, dimensional and/or table environments.
Build and maintain positive relationships with client staff at all levels;
Be updated on the latest technological trends in the field of Analytics.







What will make you succeed in this position? 👇

Bachelor/Master in a field that emphasizes data analysis (Computer Science, Information Management, Mathematics, Engineering or Statistics).
Experience over 5 years in the field of Analytics, ideally in service/consulting companies.
Experience using Azure Databricks for data processing and analysis.
Proficiency in Python programming and SQL Server.
Innovative spirit with balanced customer, business and technology orientation.
Interest in challenges, commitment, integrity, maturity, ability to work as a team and a high sense of responsibility.
Fluent level of English.







Finally, we would like to tell you about the stages of our selection process.




In Our Processes You Will Do 3️ Meetings

First contact with our People First area (where we will discuss professional growth, salary band and define which areas suit you).
Second technical session where you can surprise us with all your knowledge and skills in technological environments (so we can offer you a project that matches your knowledge and interests).
Meeting with the person in charge of the team you will be joining in order to solve any doubts that may have emerged during the process.







If you have passed all the phases, good news! You will receive a call from People First where we will present our offer for you to join us, and we will be able to answer any questions you may have. When you confirm that you want to be part of the SDG family, we will start preparing everything to welcome you with great enthusiasm.




You can't join us now, but you are interested in SDG Group? Don't worry, you can go through the selection process now and we will consider you for the next job opportunities that match your professional profile.




JOIN NOW, WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

#WeAreSDG #SDGGroup #WhySDG

Title: Data Scientist - Agriculture & Nature Analytics
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You’ll work with McKinsey’s agricultural and nature analytics team (ACRE) in Brussels, Belgium, part of our Agriculture Practice and Nature & Natural Capital Service Line.

Our Agriculture Practice advises agribusiness, consumer food, government, and investor clients on strategic, marketing & sales, and operations issues, helping support industry-shaping decisions that impact the future of global food production.

The Nature & Natural Capital Service Line helps corporations, public-sector actors and institutions in enabling nature-positive outcomes by integrating biodiversity, land use, water, and ecosystem information into strategy, investment decisions, and operations.

Within this group, ACRE is a team of ~30 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on bringing cutting-edge analytics to our clients. We apply real-time data and advanced analytics or AI – generally predictive or geospatial in nature – to solve the biggest problems currently facing global agriculture and nature.

You will leverage industry knowledge and analytical expertise to provide insights both to clients as part of client service teams and within the ACRE team by strengthening the core products and algorithms we build for clients. You can expect to split your time delivering impact at clients (either remotely or on site) and building up ACRE’s core analytical offerings.

In the agriculture sector, issues to solve could include determining the suitability of growing different types of crops across different geographies, using local agronomic data and satellite imagery to determine market potential for input products, or optimizing farm operations using yield forecasting. For the nature sector, you may help public-sector clients from low- and middle-income clients define their nature conservation strategy, supporting them through geospatial analysis and your domain knowledge.

Along the way, you will receive best-in-class training in structuring business problems and serving as a client adviser, develop tech-skills through (in-person) trainings curated by big-tech companies, and have opportunities to work closely with and learn from our senior agriculture and nature leaders and industry players that are shaping the future of these fields. You will get access to unparalleled career acceleration, with a huge amount of ownership and responsibility from the get-go in a collaborative, diverse, non-hierarchical environment. You will get the opportunity to travel to client sites and attend in-person trainings, locally and around the world. Lastly, you will be able to provide direct and measurable impact towards solving some of the largest problems facing the global food-system and natural ecosystems.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Master’s in a quantitative agriculture- or nature-related field
Strong experience with agronomy/crop science, animal sciences and farm-level production systems, AND/OR nature- and natural-capital–related topics, such as biodiversity, land use, water systems, ecosystem services, or nature-related risk and impact assessment, preferred
Geospatial and spatiotemporal analysis, remote sensing, image processing, preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with the ability to develop creative and efficient solutions
Clean, efficient coding abilities in Python ideally with experience parallel processing and using cloud computing resources
Ability to design and develop geospatial workflows and pipelines for data analysis and processing; ability to use version-control & collaboration tools
Strong multitasking and parallel development abilities
Strong interpersonal communication skills
Creative, naturally curious, and willing to take intellectual risks
Able to work under competing, quickly-changing priorities, manage expectations effectively and support the team under pressure
Self-management skills and ability to work as part of an Agile team preferred
Willingness to travel up to 50%

Title: Data Scientist – Scoring Center (M/F)
Description:
Present in more than 30 countries, BNP Paribas Personal Finance leads the personal and consumer credit business. In some markets we are leaders, and we bet on innovation to open up new opportunities, in others we are a fast growing business. In all markets, we value relationships, knowledge sharing and responsible action

In practice, your day-to-day


As a Data Scientist in the Scoring Center team, you will undertake projects to build risk prediction models. Your main responsibilities will be:
As part of your modelling projects, you assess the needs expressed, define and propose the adapted deliverables and estimate their burden and time frame through an implementation plan that takes into account the challenges and constraints. You use statistical modelling methods (such as Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting…), analyze and explain the results
You lead the project, keep track of the schedule and support the implementation and monitoring of the tools issued
As part of the monitoring and optimization of the BNP Paribas Personal Finance score models, you participate in the monitoring campaigns of the scores: generation and analysis of monitoring results, diagnosis and action plan
You are also responsible for conducting or analyzing statistical studies related to risk prediction models. If necessary, you take part in analytical support missions to the Group's international entities and in the processing of audit recommendations relating to the Basel regulatory project
In addition, you actively contribute to the transversal missions of the Scoring Center: technological and methodological watch, regulatory watch, training, analytical support for the Group's international entities

The Mission is important, but so is the Team and the workplace!


Welcome to BNP Paribas Personal Finance, where you will integrate the Analytics Hub, an innovative, international and creative team. Our working language is English
You will be in the Scoring Center teams that are made up of 30 Data Scientists that will work with you. The team in Lisbon is new and everyone is growing together. You'll be surrounded by colleagues working in the same field as you, sharing ideas and experiences
We are prepared to welcome you with an initial onboarding plan, with on-the-job training, online learning and networking opportunities


What do we have to offer you?


This is a very important topic that we will address together, taking into account your training and experience.


Are you the one we are looking for?


Do you have a Degree in Data Science, Mathematics or Statistics?
Do you have a scientific background and at least 3 years of experience in a statistical or risk environment, preferably modelling in banking or insurance environment?"
Do you have good skills in Python?
Are you proficient in modelling environment or data lab and have a strong knowledge of the main data science libraries?
Do you have experience in machine models industrialization?
Are you able to work on several projects in parallel and are acknowledge for your accuracy?
Are you fluent in oral and written English?
If you recognize yourself in this description, and have a lot of enthusiasm, energy and motivation, then you are the one we are looking for!
We look forward to your application!


Our commitments


BNP Paribas is an equal opportunity employer that is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all job seekers. As a socially responsible company, we incorporate the principles of Diversity and Inclusion in our values and practices
To achieve all our goals, we intend to attract, develop, and retain different profiles, assuming diversity as an enabler and differentiator of innovation, fundamental in our organization


What makes us proud as reference employer?


Top Employer Portugal and Top Employer Europe certification, for the seventh consecutive year
92% of our employees identify BNP Paribas as a company with "an inclusive management that supports all kinds of differences (age, origins, sexual orientation ...)"
93% of employees identify with and benefit from the "Smart Working" policy, feeling comfortable in a hybrid work environment, and with the digital tools and workspaces available
71% of our customers are promoters of our brand

Title: Senior Business Strategy Analyst
Description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?







We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.   










Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 










It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 










Ready to awaken your best with us? 







 





About The Role


We are looking for a Senior Business Strategy Analyst to drive commercial excellence and regional performance for Emma's European D2C business. You will be responsible for building scalable frameworks, processes, and cross-market initiatives that enable country teams to deliver consistent results and accelerate EU growth.




You'll report to the Business Strategy Manager and work closely with Ecommerce Country Teams, Global Marketing, Category Management, and Webshop and Operations.







What You'll Do:


Own and drive regional commercial excellence by defining scalable campaign structures, testing pipelines, and implementation playbooks that deliver measurable impact across EU markets


Lead high-impact cross-country initiatives that create regional advantage, embed best practices, and establish clear decision-making models across European markets


Build scalable systems and processes that enable local country teams to deliver consistent commercial results independently while maintaining strong regional alignment


Lead strategic projects at the intersection of operations, commercial strategy, and execution, ensuring Europe-wide coordination, accountability, and business impact


Drive forward-looking forecasting, budget planning, and market performance visibility in alignment with country teams, Controlling, and P&L ownership


Monitor process governance and KPIs across markets, identifying risks and growth opportunities to accelerate Emma's EU commercial performance


Act as a strategic sparring partner to country teams, enabling knowledge transfer, performance scaling, and alignment while respecting local market ownership


Partner cross-functionally with Global Marketing, Category Management, and Webshop and Operations to align on trends, priorities, and commercial execution








Who We're Looking For:


You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering or a related field


You have 3–5+ years of experience in business operations, strategy, or consulting, ideally within e-commerce or performance-driven commercial environments


You are skilled in translating campaign mechanics, financial KPIs, and supply constraints into coherent regional planning and structured execution


You are data-led and commercially sharp — you use data to make decisions, quantify impact, and challenge assumptions in campaign and financial planning


You act with full ownership mentality: you define the "how," drive initiatives forward independently, and thrive without waiting for perfect conditions


You lead by influence, not authority — you bring cross-functional teams together and drive alignment between Global, Regional, and Local stakeholders


You are fluent in English and communicate with clarity and confidence across multicultural, distributed, international teams








What We Offer:


The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change


Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo


A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events


A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities


Private Health Insurance and 24 vacation days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 29 days per year)


A flexible hybrid setup with up to 22 remote days per quarter


A modern, pet-friendly office in Parque das Nações, Lisbon















Become an Emmie 








We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  










We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 










Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.   










Upon your consent, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as get the interviews transcript and summarised by AI. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to privacy@emma-sleep.com

Title: Credit Risk Modelling Consultant
Description:
At PwC, we focus on creating a promising future where trust and innovation go side by side. Do you want to face this challenge with us?

A career in our Technology practice, will provide you with the opportunity to help clients seize essential advantages by working alongside business leaders to solve their toughest problems and capture their greatest opportunities.

The role - Credit Risk Modelling Consultant

Responsibilities

As a Credit Risk Modelling Consultant, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:


Development of statistical models for decision-making, assessment, or credit risk monitoring (e.g. PD, LGD, CCF, EWS) – whether in the prudential sphere (IRB/Pillar 2) or within the IFRS9 framework – in line with international best practices
Validation and/or audit of models used in credit risk management
Ability to support clients in identifying key areas for action in model risk management, as well as developing training sessions on the aforementioned topics
Monitoring key market trends and regulatory developments governing the use of models and/or internal or external data, based on best practices in model risk management.


Your profile


BSc or MSc in Mathematics, Statistics, Management, Finance, Economics, or similar fields
Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the financial sector, preferably in roles related to credit risk management
Proficiency in statistical software and data exploration tools (e.g. SAS, SQL, R, Python)
Fluent in both written and spoken English and Portuguese.


We believe that success lies in people and in your willingness to push boundaries. If this resonates with you, you've found your place. It's time to bring your expertise to the 'Team PwC' and drive impactful change.

We spark curiosity so you can do inspiring work.

Title: Sales support and strategic sales projects
Description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a Senior Professional in Strategic Sales Operations, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring business continuity for the Sales Distributed unit across the Nordics, Western, and South West Europe region. Imagine leading the operational effectiveness of our sales team supporting the Gas Services business, focusing on Sales Operations and Process Management, Strategic Sales Project Support, and Sales Data Analysis and Reporting. You will engage with cross-functional teams, manage complex projects, and develop strategic service sales initiatives, all while driving operational excellence and strategic contributions that shape our future.

How You’ll Make An Impact


You will manage and support the end-to-end sales process within the CRM system (e.g., Salesforce), ensuring seamless opportunity creation to order processing.
Act as a primary liaison between the sales team and departments such as finance, legal, and project execution to guarantee proposal accuracy and compliance.
Oversee order management activities, ensuring timely processing and resolution of customer or operational issues.
You will support the development and execution of regional sales strategies, collaborating with sales leadership to enhance market penetration and competitive positioning.
Develop and maintain sales performance dashboards and reports using tools like Power BI or Tableau, providing actionable insights to leadership.



What You Bring


You have 5+ years of experience in sales operations, strategic planning, or business analysis, ideally within the energy or industrial sector.
Proficiency in Salesforce and data analysis tools such as Power BI or Tableau is essential for success in this role.
You possess strong analytical skills and business acumen, enabling you to track performance against KPIs and identify trends.
A technical understanding of gas turbine machinery is crucial, along with a proactive and creative mindset to develop innovative business solutions.
You are fluent in English, with excellent communication skills to engage with clients and stakeholders effectively.



About The Team

You will be part of a dynamic team focused on selling services for small gas turbines. The team is organized into two groups: Client Managers who maintain direct contact with clients and back-office professionals who prepare offers and manage internal systems. Together, you will drive strategic initiatives and foster collaboration to enhance our service offerings in the region.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With over 100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one-sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: Siemens Energy Careers

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:


Opportunities to work with a global team
Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
Medical benefits
Remote/Flexible work
Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave
Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform
Access to a variety of employee resource groups

Title: MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER | DIR INTELIG ARTIFICIAL-CENT EXCELENCIA (CEIA)
HTML:
Descrição de emprego:

A nossa missão:

Promover o desenvolvimento e aquisição de competências de Inteligência Artificial (IA), através de um ecossistema colaborativo interno e externo, que permita introduzir IA, em escala, em todas as funções do banco, assegurando níveis de personalização, inovação e eficiência que rivalizem com os dos concorrentes nativos digitais.

O Data Scientist será responsável por apoiar a análise e interpretação de grandes volumes de dados, contribuindo para a geração de insights que suportem decisões estratégicas, muito apoiadas em ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial. Trabalhará em estreita colaboração com diferentes equipas, apoiando iniciativas baseadas em dados.

Descrição da função/Principais responsabilidades:
  • Apoiar a recolha, limpeza e preparação de dados para análise;

  • Desenvolver visualizações e dashboards usando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou similares;

  • Construir modelos estatísticos e preditivos com supervisão de cientistas de dados sénior;

  • Realizar análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências;

  • Documentar procedimentos e manter o código bem organizado e reutilizável;

  • Colaborar com stakeholders para compreender requisitos de negócio e traduzir em análises.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Mestrado ou PhD em Estatística, Matemática, Informática, Engenharia ou área relacionada;

  • 2 a 3 anos de experiência profissional com Python, R ou SQL;

  • Conhecimentos básicos de Bash e Git;

  • Conhecimentos de Machine Learning e estatística;

  • Experiência na formação e teste de modelos, no tratamento de grandes volumes de dados e na aplicação de técnicas de Data Science para lidar com redução de dimensionalidade, leakage, overfitting, entre outros;

  • Boas capacidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;

  • Curiosidade intelectual e vontade de aprender continuamente.

Requisitos preferenciais:
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de modelos em ambientes cloud, como o GCP.
  • Experiência em monitorização de performance de modelos.
  • Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial Generativa e/ou Visão Computacional.

Title: Data Analyst - Europe
Description:
Job Type

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

About Hiscox

Hiscox is an international insurer specialising in luxury goods and property markets, as well as high-end professional insurance. As experts in risk, we empower individuals and businesses to achieve their ambitions. With offices in nine European countries, we have a highly international workforce and foster a culture of inclusion, collaboration, and personal and professional growth.

About The Hiscox Data Team

The Europe Data Team is a cross-country, multidisciplinary group responsible for driving and enabling Hiscox Europe’s data capabilities. We combine expertise in Data Engineering, Data Analysis, and Data Management to deliver high-quality data pipelines, insightful reporting, and strong governance frameworks, working closely with business teams across Europe.

Our mission is to ensure trusted, consistent, and accessible data that empowers smarter decision-making and supports the evolution of the enterprise Hiscox Data Strategy.

The Role

The Data Analyst for the Europe Data Team analyses business requirements and available data across our European analytics platform, which uses Microsoft Azure and Databricks. This role clarifies business needs, identifies improvements, and helps guide the platform’s development in line with the Hiscox Data Strategy.

Working with technical teams, the Data Analyst defines solutions to deliver reliable and accurate insights for functions such as Sales, Underwriting, and Finance, using tools such as Power BI and collaborating with diverse stakeholders.

With ongoing data transformation across Europe, this position offers the opportunity to shape strategic outcomes while supporting daily operations and existing commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Business & Data Analysis


Analyse and document business requirements to support reporting and analytical needs.
Perform data analysis and discovery across multiple sources to validate data quality, identify gaps, and support decision-making.
Extract and prepare data to support ad hoc business requests.
Monitor analytical platform outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with business expectations.



Data Modelling & Mapping


Support data modelling and mapping activities, ensuring that business rules are correctly defined and implemented.
Analyse data from various systems to support the mapping processes feeding the European Data Platform.



Collaboration & Solution Design


Work closely with data engineers and business stakeholders to translate and align functional requirements into effective technical solutions.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes, standards, and platform evolution.



Reporting & Visualisation (Power BI)


Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that deliver actionable insights to stakeholders.
Build and manage data models, relationships, and calculations within Power BI.
Apply best practices in data visualisation to create clear and impactful dashboards.
Stay up to date with new Power BI features and industry trends to continuously improve reporting capabilities.



Skills

Technical Skills


Good understanding of data mapping and business intelligence concepts.
Knowledge of data modelling techniques, including star schema.
Experience using SQL to query and manipulate data.
Hands-on experience with Power BI, including report creation, data modelling, and DAX.
Experience with Databricks, or exposure to Databricks-based data and analytics environments, would be advantageous.



Functional Skills


Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain insights to non-technical stakeholders.
At least three years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data and Analytics roles.
Experience in functional analysis, ideally within the insurance industry.



Education & Languages


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.
Fluent English, both spoken and written.



Person Specification


Self-motivated and able to work independently while contributing effectively to a team.
Positive attitude and a strong interest in creating value from data.
Able to communicate ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Skilled at translating business needs into practical technical solutions.
Strong relationship-building skills with end users.
Comfortable working in environments with ambiguity and change.
Flexible, adaptable, and resilient.



Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

Title: Senior Credit Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job


The Senior Credit Data Analyst performs continuous data analysis on the group’s credit risk parameters and their impact on Risk Weight Assets calculation


Your Main Activities Are


Investigate, analyse and control the calculation of Risk Weight Assets, monitor and explain
Participate in testing new implementations, gathering, and documenting data on calculation or systems evolution
Collaborate with internal clients to best understand their needs towards the process and assure continuous improvement
Support, analyse and monitor the information provided for regulatory purposes
Ensure proper maintenance of documentation of all methodologies, tools, processes and procedures
Continuous participation in transversal projects, being a key participant for improvement and decision making


Profile And Skills To Success


Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Finance or Accounting
At least 3 years of professional experience in risk and controls
Knowledge of law and regulations
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office Pack (Excel and Access)
Proficient knowledge of MySQL
Fluent in English, verbal and written
Good communication skills
Teamwork and ability to collaborate
Critical thinking
Proactivity
Analytical ability


Why joining BNP Paribas?

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner


Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.


Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.


To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

Title: Data Analyst
HTML:
We are looking for a data analyst who can also develop practical tools. The main responsibility is to analyze operational data from tolling and intelligent transportation products. The candidate will use SQL and Excel to prepare data, investigate results, identify problems, and communicate findings. When analysis work benefits from automation, the candidate will use Python, Linux, and scripting to build small utilities and repeatable workflows. This is primarily a data-analysis role, not a general software-development role.

What The Candidate Must Have

Data analysis

  • Practical professional experience analyzing data;
  • Good working knowledge of SQL;
  • Good working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, filters, pivot tables, and charts;
  • Ability to clean, compare, summarize, and validate data;
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies, patterns, and outliers;
  • Ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical people.

Development support

  • Practical experience with Python;
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools;
  • Familiarity with scripting and task automation;
  • Ability to create or adapt small tools that make analysis faster or more reliable.

Working style

  • Strong analytical skills and critical-thinking ability;
  • Careful and methodical when handling data;
  • Able to question assumptions, assess evidence, and distinguish facts from interpretations;
  • Able to document assumptions, steps, and conclusions;
  • Highly autonomous and accountable for progressing work independently;
  • Comfortable working in an exploratory environment where the problem and expected outcome may not always be fully scoped;
  • Comfortable collaborating with software and operations teams;
  • Good communication in English, spoken and written.

Typical work

  • Query and analyze operational data using SQL;
  • Use Excel to explore data, produce summaries, and communicate results;
  • Check data quality and investigate unexpected results;
  • Compare data from different systems or sources;
  • Prepare concise reports and recommendations;
  • Automate repetitive preparation and analysis tasks with Python and scripts;
  • Use Linux tools to inspect files, logs, and data-processing jobs;
  • Build lightweight utilities to support analysis when needed;
  • Keep analysis steps and results understandable to other team members.

Useful, But Not Required

  • Experience with Python data-analysis libraries such as pandas;
  • Experience with operational, event, sensor, image, or other high-volume data;
  • Experience working with software, systems, or operations teams;
  • Familiarity with Git;
  • Experience in tolling or intelligent transportation.

These are advantages, not mandatory requirements. Candidates should not be excluded because they lack a specific framework, database product, degree, or software-development methodology if they can demonstrate the core skills above.

Company Context

  • International company working on tolling and intelligent transportation products;
  • Work location: Lagoas Park, Oeiras;
  • Collaboration with software, systems, data, and operations teams;
  • Documentation and collaboration in English and Portuguese;
  • The required development and data environments will be provided.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Marketing Science & AI (Founding Member) (m/f/d)
Description:
At SIXT, the SEA channel is one of our biggest growth drivers — and you will be at the heart of transforming how it's run, moving from manual campaign management toward scalable, AI-augmented, data-driven bidding. As a Senior Data Analyst for SEA Bidding & AI-Driven Performance, you will work closely with Data Science, Pricing, and Platform Engineering to optimize how millions of euros are invested in SEA. This is a high-impact, analytical role where you combine bidding strategy, experimentation, API-level automation, and AI-assisted analysis to build the infrastructure that makes optimization repeatable and future-proof. Sound like your kind of challenge? Join Team Orange and help shape the future of performance marketing at SIXT.



YOUR ROLE AT SIXT


You analyze performance data to model elasticity curves, marginal ROI, and optimal bidding thresholds — partnering with Data Science to embed algorithmic bidding models into daily operations
You design and run structured experiments on bidding strategies, pricing interactions, and keyword intent tiers, instrumenting them via the Google Ads API to enable automated allocation and real-time result capture
You use SQL and BI tools to surface inefficiencies, uncover growth opportunities, and monitor competitive dynamics to strategically reallocate spend toward higher-value areas
You build and maintain Python-based pipelines using the Google Ads API and SA360 API to automate data ingestion, bid adjustments, and campaign health monitoring
You develop dashboards that expose spend efficiency, incremental contribution, and market elasticity — enabling self-serve insights across the SEA team
You act as the analytical bridge between SEA, Data Science, Pricing, and Platform Engineering, championing data-backed, model-driven decision making while mentoring team members on hypothesis-driven work and practical AI tooling





YOUR SKILLS MATTER


Experience You bring experience in analytics, data science, or quantitative marketing, ideally from a tech, e-commerce, or mobility environment
Background You are proficient in SQL and BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, and comfortable using Python for data manipulation, scripting, and workflow automation
Knowledge You have a solid understanding of digital auction mechanics, Smart Bidding, and value-based bidding strategies, and are familiar with LTV/CAC thinking, incrementality testing, attribution modeling, and multi-channel measurement
Tools & Platforms You have hands-on experience with the Google Ads API or SA360 API, familiarity with data warehouse environments such as BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake, and exposure to algorithmic bidding systems or predictive modelling is a strong plus
Mindset You actively use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot to write and iterate faster — and you bring that energy and curiosity to the wider team and look for the next problem before being asked, and are always exploring how emerging tools can make your work — and your team's work — smarter
Soft Skills You are proactive and thrive in fast-paced, data-driven environments, translating complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders





WHAT WE OFFER


The SIXT Lisbon Experience Two of Lisbon's most exciting hubs — Factory Lisboa in Beato and ARTs Lisboa in Parque das Nações — are where you'll find your new home base. Expect a fast-paced, international atmosphere where ideas flow freely, people genuinely look out for each other, and no two days feel quite the same
Community & International Environment Join a truly global workplace with colleagues from many nationalities. Regular team events, community activities, and inspiring talks with internal and external speakers make our Lisbon hubs more than just an office
Flexibility & Modern Work Setup Benefit from a hybrid working model with two office days per week and flexible working hours. Our modern offices are designed for collaboration while allowing you the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best
AI at your fingertips From day one, you'll have access to Claude by Anthropic and SIXTgpt, SIXT's own AI platform, to supercharge your work. We invest in every team member's AI journey: encouraging experimentation, building knowledge, and making sure you're ahead of the curve
Time Off & Wellbeing Enjoy 28 vacation days per year, an additional day off on your birthday, one volunteer day annually, and private health insurance that also covers your spouse and children free of charge
Everyday Benefits Receive a yearly Coverflex allowance and a daily meal allowance to make life a little easier every day
Employee Perks Get exclusive rates on all SIXT services, with special discounts extended to your family and friends. Because great perks are even better when you can share them





About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.00 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 350,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 110 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: ETL Data Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis is looking for a versatile professional who is comfortable both "talking to the business" and "getting their hands dirty in the data pipeline." You will be responsible for understanding business data structures, writing clear technical specifications for Data Engineers, designing reporting solutions in Power BI, and actively participating in the development of our ETL flows.

As a Data Analyst / Data Engineer in our team, you will bridge the gap between business needs, data analysis, and technical data engineering. If you have a strong analytical mindset, a love for data modeling, and hands-on experience with ETL tools, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities


Business Requirements & Specifications: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear data models and technical specifications for the Data Engineering team.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Design, structure, and maintain robust data models (star schemas, snowflake schemas) optimized for analysis and reporting.
Data Governance: Ensure data quality, consistency, and clear documentation of data definitions (data lineage and data dictionary).
ETL Development: Design, build, test, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into our data warehouse.
Tooling (Stambia + Others): Develop ETL processes primarily using Stambia (training/adaptation can be provided if you have strong experience in other market-standard ETL tools like Talend, Informatica, SSIS, dbt, etc.).
Data Quality Automation: Implement automated checks to ensure the reliability and integrity of the loaded data.


Qualifications

Hard Skills:


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Finance, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in a similar role (Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer) with a strong dual focus on analysis and ETL development.
Advanced SQL skills are mandatory (complex queries, joins, optimizations, stored procedures).
Strong understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts (Kimball methodology).
Direct experience with Stambia is a major asset. Otherwise, solid experience with other ETL tools (Talend, Informatica, SSIS, Data Factory, dbt) and a strong willingness to adapt to Stambia.
Prior experience working in the banking, finance, or insurance sector (understanding of financial instruments, regulatory compliance, risk management, or retail banking data) is highly appreciated.
Design, develop, and maintain high-performing, user-friendly Power BI dashboards and reports (including DAX formulas and Power Query/M).
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Knowledge of Python or Unix/Linux scripting.
Fluency in French and English is essential.


Soft Skills


Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between business users (non-technical) and pure developers (highly technical).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Ability to take ownership of projects from requirements gathering to final delivery.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are commited to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
