Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis is looking for a versatile professional who is comfortable both "talking to the business" and "getting their hands dirty in the data pipeline." You will be responsible for understanding business data structures, writing clear technical specifications for Data Engineers, designing reporting solutions in Power BI, and actively participating in the development of our ETL flows.

As a Data Analyst / Data Engineer in our team, you will bridge the gap between business needs, data analysis, and technical data engineering. If you have a strong analytical mindset, a love for data modeling, and hands-on experience with ETL tools, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Requirements & Specifications: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear data models and technical specifications for the Data Engineering team.
  • Data Modeling & Architecture: Design, structure, and maintain robust data models (star schemas, snowflake schemas) optimized for analysis and reporting.
  • Data Governance: Ensure data quality, consistency, and clear documentation of data definitions (data lineage and data dictionary).
  • ETL Development: Design, build, test, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into our data warehouse.
  • Tooling (Stambia + Others): Develop ETL processes primarily using Stambia (training/adaptation can be provided if you have strong experience in other market-standard ETL tools like Talend, Informatica, SSIS, dbt, etc.).
  • Data Quality Automation: Implement automated checks to ensure the reliability and integrity of the loaded data.

Qualifications

Hard Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Finance, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in a similar role (Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer) with a strong dual focus on analysis and ETL development.
  • Advanced SQL skills are mandatory (complex queries, joins, optimizations, stored procedures).
  • Strong understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts (Kimball methodology).
  • Direct experience with Stambia is a major asset. Otherwise, solid experience with other ETL tools (Talend, Informatica, SSIS, Data Factory, dbt) and a strong willingness to adapt to Stambia.
  • Prior experience working in the banking, finance, or insurance sector (understanding of financial instruments, regulatory compliance, risk management, or retail banking data) is highly appreciated.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performing, user-friendly Power BI dashboards and reports (including DAX formulas and Power Query/M).
  • Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of Python or Unix/Linux scripting.
  • Fluency in French and English is essential.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between business users (non-technical) and pure developers (highly technical).
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
  • Ability to take ownership of projects from requirements gathering to final delivery.

We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are commited to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Partnership Net is revolutionizing the €90B sponsorship industry with its innovative AI-powered Agent-as-a-Service platform. By transforming sponsorships into a transparent, data-driven, and measurable process, we empower brands and rights holders to optimize ROI, maximize value, and discover new opportunities. Our solutions enable organizations to shift from intuition-based decisions to insights derived from data analytics, driving effective partnerships in a continually evolving market. At Partnership Net, we are committed to setting new standards and delivering actionable intelligence for our clients.




Role Description

This is a full-time hybrid role for a Data Analyst, located in the Greater Aveiro Area with some flexibility to work from home. As a Data Analyst with Partnership Net, you will analyze, interpret, and present data to support strategic business decisions. Core responsibilities will include collecting and preparing data, creating and refining data models, applying the highest quality standards, developing actionable insights, and effectively communicating findings to stakeholders. You will play a key role in transforming data into valuable business solutions to drive our company’s mission forward.




Qualifications

Proficiency in Analytical Skills, Data Analytics, and Statistics to analyze data and uncover insights.
Expertise in Data Modeling to design and implement effective database models for business needs.
Strong Communication skills to present data insights clearly to stakeholders and collaborate effectively with team members.
Proficient in using analytical tools and platforms such as SQL, Python, or R.
Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience implementing the highest quality standards and automation procedures.
Detail oriented with strong values working and collaborating towards the best result.
Ability to work in a hybrid environment, balancing in-office and remote work as needed.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Familiarity with the sponsorship or marketing industry is a plus.




Benefits

28 paid vacation days per year + birthday off
Public transport costs reimbursement
Health insurance
Monthly subscription service budget
10 min train journey from Aveiro to the office
Multinational young team environment
Hybrid working mode ﻿

Description:
At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. Job Description

We are looking for a sharp and insightful Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence (BI) team. You will be the crucial link between raw data and strategic decisions, responsible for gathering business requirements, transforming complex data, and creating compelling visualizations that drive action across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and translate business needs into technical requirements for data models and reporting solutions.
Develop, optimize, and execute SQL queries to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Design and build dynamic dashboards and reports, primarily using Power BI, to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable business insights.
Perform root-cause analysis on data discrepancies and collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure data quality and availability.
Present findings and strategic recommendations to stakeholders, clearly communicating complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Participate in the full lifecycle of BI projects, from requirements gathering to final deployment.



Qualifications


3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar role focused on data and reporting.
Strong mandatory proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets.
Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, data manipulation, automation, and scripting (e.g., using Pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries).
Expert hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI (or similar BI tools) for data modeling, visualization, and publishing reports.
Proven ability to gather, document, and manage business requirements effectively.
Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with data.
Experience with Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling is expected.



Valued Skills:


Experience with other components of the Microsoft Data Stack (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Analysis Services).
Knowledge of Data Modeling principles (e.g., Dimensional Modeling).
Professional fluency (B2+) in French is highly valued and may be a mandatory requirement for allocation on specific projects with Francophone clients.



Additional Information

The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. We are convinced that diversity contributes to the creativity, dynamism and excellence of our organization. All of our vacancies are open to people with disabilities.

Title: Junior Healthcare Data Analyst
HTML:
Learn About Knok

At knok, we dare to lead and humanise the digital transformation of healthcare. We envision a world where everyone has timely access to quality healthcare through digital technology, creating a more equal society. We genuinely believe in it, and you can recognise it in every person who embraces this mission.

Through a Digital Front Door strategy, knok connects patients, providers and healthcare professionals in one place. Our API-first white-label platform enables a continuous, engaging and personalised healthcare experience for all conditions through a cutting-edge Patient Journey Engine.

With regular clinical practice as our main source of knowledge, we leverage ready-to-use data to improve care automation and increase financial savings. Since 2015, we have enabled more than 2.5 million clinical interactions in over 12 countries. Our platform is scalable and AI-ready, enhancing the power of data-driven care to deliver better outcomes during all stages of life.

Are you ready to join us in revolutionising healthcare and making a tangible impact on people's lives?

About The Role

We are looking for a Junior Healthcare Data Analyst to support our teams in turning complex healthcare data into meaningful insights. You'll be working with datasets from different sources, such as clinical operations, insurance processing, and patient journeys - helping us improve care delivery and decision-making.

If you're passionate about using data to make healthcare more accessible and effective, don't stop here - dive deeper!

As an Junior Healthcare Data Analyst, you will:

  • Collect, clean, and analyse healthcare data from multiple sources (e.g. EHR, patient demographics, operational systems), to extract meaningful insights;
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations to communicate key metrics and findings to stakeholders, including clinicians, operational teams and leadership team;
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the organisation, including data science, product management, and clinical operations, to support data-driven decision-making;
  • Perform statistical analysis to support population health management, risk stratification, and clinical outcome optimisation;
  • Contribute to improving data quality by identifying data quality issues and anomalies, and work with relevant stakeholders to address and resolve them

What Makes You a Great Fit For This Journey

  • Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Statistics, Biomedical Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred;
  • Experience (academic or professional) with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar;
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining and segmentation techniques;
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear insights that support better decision-making;
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling;
  • Ability to explain a dashboard or an analysis to someone without a technical background, in a simple and practical way;
  • Care when working with data to ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability;
  • Ability to manage several analytical tasks at the same time, prioritising what has the greatest impact on the business and patients

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SQL;
  • Experience with Apache Superset;
  • Previous experience or exposure to the healthcare sector

Recruitment stages

  • People Interview: A conversation to get to know you better, explore your background and motivation, and introduce you to knok, our culture, and the role.
  • Case Study: A practical exercise designed to understand how you approach data, structure your analysis, and turn information into meaningful insights.
  • Final Interview: A conversation with the Hiring Manager where you'll present your case study, explain your reasoning, and discuss your approach in more detail

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose


As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.


Responsibilities


Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.


Education


Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.


Experience


Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.

Title: Data Analyst | Power BI & Microsoft Fabric
HTML:
Data Analyst | Power BI & Microsoft Fabric

Localização: Rio Tinto (Gondomar)

Regime: Híbrido

Projeto: Setor Retail


Na Mootiva, estamos a recrutar um Data Analyst | Power BI & Microsoft Fabric para integrar um projeto no setor do Retail, com foco no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Business Intelligence à escala empresarial.

Procuramos um perfil hands-on, com experiência sólida e recente em Power BI e Microsoft Fabric, capaz de desenhar, desenvolver e garantir a governação de soluções analíticas seguras, escaláveis e de elevada performance.


Sobre a função

Este profissional irá trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders de negócio e equipas de Data Engineering e Data Platform, transformando necessidades de negócio em soluções de BI robustas e escaláveis para diferentes áreas e geografias.


Responsabilidades principais

  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis utilizando Power BI e Microsoft Fabric;
  • Desenvolver e manter reports, dashboards e modelos semânticos empresariais em Power BI;
  • Criar métricas e frameworks de KPIs através de DAX avançado;
  • Gerir ambientes Power BI Service, incluindo Workspaces, Apps, Gateways, refreshes, semantic models e Deployment Pipelines;
  • Implementar Row-Level Security (RLS) e mecanismos adequados de controlo de acessos;
  • Otimizar reports e modelos semânticos ao nível da performance e escalabilidade;
  • Desenhar soluções em Microsoft Fabric, utilizando OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse e Data Factory;
  • Integrar e transformar dados provenientes de SQL, APIs, plataformas cloud e ficheiros;
  • Apoiar práticas de governance, data quality, lineage, monitoring, testing e release management;
  • Colaborar com equipas técnicas, participar na revisão de soluções e apoiar outros analistas ou developers.


Perfil

  • Experiência profissional mínima de 3 anos, com senioridade adequada à função;
  • Experiência avançada e hands-on com Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX e Semantic Modelling;
  • Experiência prática e recente com Microsoft Fabric;
  • Bons conhecimentos de SQL e Power Query/M;
  • Experiência em modelação dimensional, nomeadamente Star Schema, Fact e Dimension Modelling;
  • Experiência na gestão de ambientes empresariais Power BI: Workspaces, Apps, Gateways e Deployment Pipelines;
  • Experiência na implementação de Row-Level Security e boas práticas de governance e segurança em BI;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse e Data Factory;
  • Capacidade para analisar problemas de performance e otimizar soluções Power BI e Fabric;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, gestão de stakeholders e resolução de problemas;
  • Português nativo ou fluente – obrigatório;
  • Conhecimentos de inglês serão valorizados.


Valorizamos também

  • Experiência com Direct Lake, Composite Models, XMLA, Tabular Editor, TMDL ou Calculation Groups;
  • Conhecimentos de DAX Studio, VertiPaq Analyzer ou outras ferramentas de performance tuning;
  • Experiência com Microsoft Purview, Fabric Capacity Management, Power BI REST APIs ou automação;
  • Conhecimentos de CI/CD, Source Control e Azure Data Services;
  • Experiência em implementações internacionais ou ambientes de grande escala.


Se tens experiência sólida em Power BI e Microsoft Fabric e procuras um novo desafio onde possas contribuir para soluções de Business Intelligence de dimensão empresarial, queremos conhecer-te.


Na Mootiva, ligamos talento à inovação. Junta-te a nós.

Description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.




How You'll Make an Impact:

We are seeking a dynamic Data Reports & Insights Analyst

to join our Customer Success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence. As a Reports & Insights Analyst, you'll help Cloudbeds customers turn raw operational and financial data into decisions they can act on. You'll build, analyze, and optimize reports across our PMS reporting suite, troubleshoot discrepancies before they become customer frustrations, and coach hoteliers on how to read metrics like ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and channel performance with confidence. Every report you refine and every question you answer on calls or emails directly shapes how hospitality businesses understand their own performance and grow their revenue.




Our Team:

Data Services sits at the intersection of hospitality expertise and reporting technology, working to make sure Cloudbeds customers never have to guess what their numbers mean. Reporting to your lead, you'll join a team that partners closely with Product, Onboarding, Support, and Customer Success to keep improving how customers access and interpret their data. It's a hands-on, collaborative group that treats every reporting question as a chance to make the platform and the customer's business a little smarter.




What You Bring to the Team:

You've spent time inside hotels and property management systems; you understand hospitality data isn't just numbers on a screen; it's occupancy, revenue, and guest behaviour telling a story. You're comfortable with advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas) and have worked with BI or reporting tools involving dashboards, filters, and custom reports. You communicate clearly in written and verbal English, translating technical reporting concepts into plain language for customers who may not be data experts. You're detail-oriented, adaptable to shifting priorities, and genuinely enjoy solving the puzzle when a report doesn't add up.




What Sets You Up for Success:

Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems, channel managers, and similar systems
Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users.
Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning).
Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records.
Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions.




Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional):

Multilingual Capabilities: Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish or Portuguese.
BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures.




What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.




Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Assegurar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de Business Intelligence, Reporting e integração de dados, transformando informação dispersa em conhecimento útil para o negócio, apoiando as diferentes áreas da empresa na tomada de decisão.

Our goal? To deliver the highest level of service, reliability, and efficiency to our clients, both internal and external, by offering diverse processes and services aligned with the insurance industry's best practices.

Ready to kick off your next professional chapter with us?

Become our new Finance Data Analyst based in Porto

BE PART OF OUR DYNAMIC TEAM OF DONNEES DAR (DFAR)

Be part of our dynamic DFAR team, a specialized data unit inside of the Data Team that designs and operates automated solutions to collect and deliver high-quality data for Finance, Accounting, Actuarial, and Risk functions. Using tools such as Power BI, SAS/SQL, Python, and ETL processes, the team streamlines financial and operational workflows from data input to business insights, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and actionable decision-making for internal stakeholders.

YOUR FUTURE MISSION IN THE DFAR TEAM

Your Key Responsibilities Will Be

  • Finance Analysis and Business Support, including performing financial and accounting analysis and reconciliation activities;
  • Collaborate with business teams to translate functional requirements into scalable analytical solutions;
  • Develop interactive dashboards to monitor financial KPIs, data quality, and risk indicators, translating business requirements into visual and analytical reporting tools;
  • Analyze data transformation processes and measure quality through control frameworks, whilst proposing remediation plans using automation solutions and validation rules;
  • Participate in data quality governance initiatives, ensuring alignment with finance and accounting standards.

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? HERE’S WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Degree in Data Science, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Actuarial Science, Data Engineering, or related fields;
  • 4+ years of professional background in financial data analysis, including hands-on experience in finance/accounting environments, financial reporting activities and/or dashboard development;
  • Understanding of accounting principles, reconciliation processes and P&L/Balance Sheet concepts;
  • Strong technical skills, including experience with Power BI, Python and SQL (ideal)
  • Fluent in English. Fluency in French would be an additional advantage

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

In addition to our attractive salary, here’s a glimpse of what you can expect from us:

  • Generous Perks: Enjoy meal, child and monthly flexible benefits allowances as part of our comprehensive benefits package.

Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen und haben Erfahrung mit Datenbanken sowie Datenvisualisierungstools

Title: SAP Business Intelligence & Data Analytics Specialist (m/f/d)
Description:
Your role in our team

As a Data Scientist (m/f/d), you will drive data-driven decision-making across our organization. You will design and develop new data products for our service business, with a particular focus on company-wide reporting. In the future, you will also support organizational development through the introduction and application of process mining tools for process analysis and optimization.

In addition, you will be responsible for further data-related development initiatives and provide valuable insights through your analyses to support strategic decision-making. Your work will strengthen a data-driven culture and enable data-powered services, giving you a direct impact on the success of the entire organization.



Design and develop data models based on SAP Datasphere
Create analytical dashboards and reports with defined KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and identify optimization opportunities based on the results
Implement, document, and roll out developed data models
Lead data-driven projects and initiatives as a Project Manager or Program Manager
Build and implement a Process Mining solution to enable root cause analyses



Your profile



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related field
Strong passion for data, analytics, and business processes, combined with excellent conceptual thinking skills
Strong technical capabilities and the ability to solve complex business challenges in a structured manner
Good understanding of business contexts and the ability to identify opportunities where data analytics can improve processes and performance
Solid knowledge of data analysis methods and models
Confident working with large datasets and experienced in using databases and data visualization tools
Proficient to advanced knowledge of SQL and practical experience with SAP; knowledge of Python is an advantage
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly, persuasively, and in a stakeholder-oriented manner



Your Benefits



Thrive in an international, collaborative and fun work environment
Meaningful and challenging responsibilities that make a difference in a fast-growing industry
Diverse opportunities for further development
Competitive compensation package
Modern office, flexible working time and remote work option

Title: Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis in Portugal is currently seeking a Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI to join its BPCE SI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques) team, within the IT (Information Technologies) department, to work in a hybrid work model in the Porto office, to join a data team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and our Data teams (Data Engineers, Data Analysts). To succeed in this mission, you will not just gather requirements: you will actively dive into the data by writing queries and analyzing our Oracle database tables to understand their structure, quality, and underlying logic.

Key Responsibilities


Write SQL queries to directly query and analyze tables within our database.
Explore and profile raw data to understand its structure, underlying business rules, and to identify potential anomalies.
Work closely with Data teams (Data Engineers, BI, and Analytics) to translate functional business rules into technical requirements.
Draft clear functional and technical specifications (source-to-target data mapping).
Assist business stakeholders in defining their requirements by providing a realistic view of the data actually available in the Oracle systems.
Design and execute test plans (both functional and technical data reconciliation).


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL (Essential): Strong ability to write complex queries (JOINs, subqueries, analytical functions, etc.) to query databases.
5+ years of solid experience as business analyst.
Oracle Environment: Proven experience working with Oracle databases (using tools such as PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver, or SQL Developer).
Data Analysis: Ability to analyze data models (tables, views, primary/foreign keys).
Data Modeling: Basic understanding of data architecture concepts (Data Warehouse, Data Marts).
French: Minimum C1 level (fluent/advanced) is required, as you will interact closely with French-speaking business stakeholders and write functional specifications in French. A good level of English is also required.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Title: Graduate Programme 2027: Data Scientist and Analyst
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Graduate Programme

Our Graduate Programme is built for ambitious graduates who want to launch their careers in fintech. Over this 12-month programme, you’ll work on real projects, solve complex challenges, and make an impact from day one. With structured training and hands-on experience, you’ll grow your skills while exploring different areas of the business.

Top performers can be promoted during or after the programme, giving you the chance to continue your journey at Revolut.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for Graduate Data Scientists and Analysts who are analytical, curious, and ready to deliver impact with data.

You’ll begin with an immersive boot camp designed to give you hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle. After that, you'll join a dedicated product team to specialise in your preferred data domain.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Graduate Programme is open to international applicants willing to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, Spain, the UK, or the UAE. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).

Key dates


Applications: open from May 2026
Recruitment process: July–December 2026
Programme start: early 2027 (January–June) or late 2027 (July–December)


Roles are filled on a rolling basis, so apply early. You can specify your preferred intake during the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing


Taking part in a hands-on bootcamp and working on real projects across multiple teams
Helping to build analytical tools and machine learning models (such as dashboards and ETLs) to support product launches
Improving visibility in user sign-up flows and operational funnels
Enhancing and maintaining data infrastructure (including ETLs and LookML) to keep data accessible and reliable
Collaborating with teams across Operations, Growth, and Product to refine features and uncover insights
Supporting decision-making with ad-hoc analysis (e.g., interest rate sensitivity, incentive profitability, conversion rates)
Learning from industry leaders and staying aligned with team priorities through weekly meetings
Managing tasks, tracking progress, and communicating key outcomes
Sharing updates with our global teams
Receiving regular feedback to guide your development


What You'll Need


A predicted or achieved 2:1 (or equivalent grade) in computer science, maths, physics, or a related field
To have graduated in 2025, 2026, or 2027
Impressive Python and SQL skills
A solid foundation in maths and statistics
An interest in analytics engineering, product analytics, data science, or ML engineering
Great problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset
Fluency in English and excellent communication skills
Full-time availability from early or late 2027
The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

Title: Junior RGM Analyst (M/F/D)
HTML:
About us

Dorel Juvenile is the world's leading juvenile products company. Our products are available in more than 100 countries. We help families live carefree lives by providing them with juvenile products that rank highest in consumer reviews. That's what sets our products apart; durable, helpful, and caring.


Your Mission

Join the Finance department of Dorel Juvenile Europe and become part of the Revenue Growth Management Team. As a Junior RGM Analyst, you will collaborate closely with various departments – Sales, Product, Marketing – to drive and execute revenue optimization initiatives.

As part of RGM team you will contribute to transform commercial and financial data into strategic recommendations, ensuring that every commercial decision creates value for both the company and our partners.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze sales, pricing and margin data to explain results as well as identify trends and pinpoint improvement opportunities;
  • Assist in revenue budgeting and forecasting, leveraging RGM data and insights to set sales targets;
  • Generate clear and concise reports to effectively communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders;
  • Centralize pricing framework management and coordinate adjustments in collaboration with cross-functional teams.


Your Profile

  • Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or related field;
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in finance analysis, preferably within a business environment;
  • Advanced proficiency in of Excel. Plus: Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., Power BI);
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to present information clearly;
  • Outstanding analytical skills, agility and ability to translate data into actionable insights;
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment;
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn and growth;
  • Problem solving and results-oriented mindset;
  • High attention to detail and ability to connect the dots;
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.


What we offer

  • A salary between 21.324€ and 24.324€ gross annual, based on your experience and knowledge, with room to grow.
  • This is a position for 40 hours per week.
  • You are eligible for 15 months every year.
  • The option is to work hybrid up to 3 days, with 2 joint office days.
  • The entitlement to annual leave can be up to 26 days, according to internal policy.
  • Other benefits include health insurance (covering the employee), bus and several partnerships, such as with gyms, clinics offering wellness services, banks, and more.


Are you ready to grow with us?

The people behind our products and brands make Dorel Juvenile an even stronger company. We are extending our leading market position and believe team spirit, personal drive, and accountability can make a real difference in achieving sustainable growth. This is essential for our future. We invite you to grow with us!

Do you want to be part of the growth of the next generation? Dorel needs your contribution! Send your resume in English.

Only the candidates with the pretended profile will be contacted in two weeks’ time

Title: Manager GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management team is looking for a Manager Reporting Analytics to deliver operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and enable self-service analytics through Power BI.

The role combines reporting solution development, problem solving, and stakeholder engagement, acting as a bridge between business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and effective reporting solutions

Key Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards by leveraging existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Partner with business stakeholders to gather and translate business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Investigate reporting and data issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and collaborate with the Supply Chain Intelligence and Data Domain teams on global capabilities issues.
Manage reporting demand by triaging requests, prioritizing work, and coordinating the delivery of reporting solutions.
Support and enable the Power User community by providing technical guidance, promoting self-service analytics, and driving reporting best practices.
Drive continuous improvements to reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI governance across Supply Planning operational teams.
Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) and adoption of new and enhanced reporting solutions.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI reporting solutions, including DAX, data modelling, and performance optimization for operational reporting.
Data & Technical Skills: Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate reporting issues and ensure data accuracy.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business processes, gather requirements, and translate them into practical, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to investigate reporting and data issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate resolutions or escalation paths.
Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and the Power User community, adapting communication to different audiences.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams to deliver reporting enhancements, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and drive successful adoption of new reporting capabilities.
Continuous Improvement: Proactive approach to improving reporting processes, development standards, data quality, and self-service analytics through innovation and best practices.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a dynamic, global environment.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks). Experience with Python is an advantage.
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.


adidas celebrates diversity, supports inclusiveness and encourages individual expression in our workplace. We do not tolerate the harassment or discrimination toward any of our applicants or employees. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee (IEFP)
Description:
Join us as a Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee!

As a Business Intelligence /Data analytics Engineer Trainee you will design, build, and maintain scalable analytics solutions that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reliable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Accountabilities

You will primarily be responsible for:


Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and business insights.
Develop and evaluate machine learning models for supervised and unsupervised learning tasks.
Prepare datasets for statistical analysis and predictive modelling.
Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in data engineering, analytics, and data science.
Designing and maintaining semantic data models (star/snowflake schemas) optimized for analytics and reporting.
Building and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Ensure data quality, consistency and performance across business intelligence solutions.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Python and R.
Translating business requirements into robust BI solutions and flexible Power BI semantic models.
Optimizing SQL queries, data models and report performance for large-scale datasets, monitoring BI workloads in cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborating with business users to understand KPIs, metrics and reporting needs, and partnering with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Product teams.
Providing guidance and best practices to analysts and report developers.
Defining and enforcing data standards, naming conventions and documentation, supporting data lineage and metadata management.
Ensuring compliance with security and privacy requirements.


Knowledge, Skills And Experience Required


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering or related fields.
Eligible for an IEFP Level VI Internship.
Good programming skills; knowledge of python, C#.
Machine learning model development and evaluation.
Data wrangling using libraries such as Pandas/Modin, Polars, NumPy.
Knowledge of multiple databases such as SQLServer, PostgreSQL, DuckDB.
API-based data ingestion.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Big Query, Redshift, SQL Server).
Hands-on with Power BI (semantic models, DAX, DirectQuery) and ETL/ELT tools (SSIS, ADF, Airflow, dbt, SSIS or similar).
Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Azure Foundry (Nice to have).
Knowledge of data modelling techniques (Kimball, dimensional modelling).
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data models and KPIs.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Organized, able to manage multiple priorities and share knowledge effectively.
Fluent in English, with good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
Nice to have: experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), Python, DevOps/CI-CD for BI, data governance frameworks.


Apply by submitting your CV in English.

Title: HR Reporting and Analytics Manager
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



The HR Reporting and Analytics Manager is responsible for managing HR data and analytics to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.



Responsibilities



Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.
Lead and mentor HR Reporting and Analytics team, ensuring effective task assignment, skills development and alignment with team and business goals. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and professional growth within the team.



Education



Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.



Experience



Proven experience in HR reporting, data analytics, and data management within a corporate environment.
Strong knowledge of HR systems (such as SAP SuccessFactors), data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and data governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data, communicate insights effectively, and align reporting strategies with business objectives.
Excellent leadership and project management skills, with a focus on driving results and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Tools and data governance

Data Management

HR Acumen

Innovation

Title: Performance Marketing & Analytics Specialist
HTML:
Procuramos um(a) Performance Marketing & Analytics Specialist para integrar a nossa equipa de Marketing, com responsabilidade pela gestão, acompanhamentoe otimização das campanhas de publicidade digital, auditoria de tracking e análise de dados.

Esta pessoa será responsável por garantir a máxima eficiência do investimento em Paid Media, acompanhando indicadores de performance, assegurar o correto tracking e integração de dados de tráfego/vendas e transformar dados em informação estratégica para a tomada de decisão.

Trabalhará em estreita articulação com a Coordenação de Marketing, contribuindo para a definição, execução, análise e otimização das campanhas digitais das diferentes marcas e mercados do Grupo.


Principais Responsabilidades

Paid Media

  • Gestão e otimização de campanhas em Meta Ads e Google Ads (obrigatório);
  • Valoriza-se experiência em TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads e Publicidade Programática;
  • Planeamento e criação de campanhas de aquisição, conversão e remarketing;
  • Gestão de públicos, segmentações e audiências por marca e mercado;
  • Gestão e acompanhamento rigoroso de orçamentos de publicidade;
  • Desenvolvimento, acompanhamento e análise de testes A/B;
  • Monitorização diária da performance e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua.


Performance, Tracking & Analytics 

  • Implementação, gestão e auditoria de tracking via Google Tag Manager (GTM) e Google Analytics 4 (GA4);
  • Monitorização e validação de eventos de conversão, pixels e comportamento dos utilizadores;
  • Alinhamento de dados entre plataformas de e-commerce/CRM e ferramentas de analytics;
  • Acompanhamento de KPIs globais (conversões, ROAS, CPA, taxa de conversão, faturação e receita, etc);
  • Análise da performance por campanha, canal, público, produto e mercado;
  • Identificação de tendências, desvios e oportunidades de crescimento.


Dashboards & Reporting

  • Criação, otimização e manutenção de dashboards dinâmicos, responsivos e interativos em Looker Studio (Data Studio) ou ferramentas similares;

Title: Data Collection Analyst (Performance Data)
Description:
Overview

Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.  

Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.

How do we add value?


Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.


Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.

We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!

Responsibilities


WHAT’S YOUR NEW ROLE ABOUT?
Deliver live coverage within our highest standard measures.
Post-match checks applied through the correct guideline procedures.
Expert knowledge in Performance soccer definitions and processes.
Adept at making carefully considered decisions having consulted stakeholders and weighed up


risks with minimal delays.


High knowledge in betting games processes and definitions.
Responsibility for freelancers: support on re-training, definitions and help to improve KPIs.


Required Qualifications:


DO YOU HAVE THESE ESSENTIALS?
Experience as Soccer Performance Analyst.
Excellent organization and communication skills.
English skills.
Complete understanding of collection tools and processes.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competition


Desired Qualifications:


IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD THESE DESIRABLES TOO
Spanish and Portuguese Skills and other languages.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competitions.
Organizes own and teamwork by taking into account deadlines and following the established


procedures.


Working collaboratively with a group of people in order to accomplish a task or achieve a goal.


Treats all team members in a respectful, courteous and professional manner; supports team

despite different points of views or setbacks.


Ability to engage and enable people to perform at their best.
Self–motivated and driven to succeed, focused on results and passionate about the job.
On-going learning and development and ability to apply new knowledge.
Ability to adapt to changing business needs, cultures, conditions and work responsibilities.


Why work at Stats Perform?

We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!

We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.  

We take care of our colleagues

We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.

We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.

We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform

By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.

With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

Title: Finance Data Analyst – All Genders – Fluent in English - Porto – Open Ended Contract – Hybrid
Description:
Join us at BNP Paribas Cardif Support

At our European Service Center - Cardif Support, based in both Porto and Lisbon, Portugal, we're a vibrant hub of over 600 multicultural professionals speaking more than 11 languages!

Our goal? To deliver the highest level of service, reliability, and efficiency to our clients, both internal and external, by offering diverse processes and services aligned with the insurance industry's best practices.

Ready to kick off your next professional chapter with us?

Become our new Finance Data Analyst based in Porto

BE PART OF OUR DYNAMIC TEAM OF DONNEES DAR (DFAR)

Be part of our dynamic DFAR team, a specialized data unit inside of the Data Team that designs and operates automated solutions to collect and deliver high-quality data for Finance, Accounting, Actuarial, and Risk functions. Using tools such as Power BI, SAS/SQL, Python, and ETL processes, the team streamlines financial and operational workflows from data input to business insights, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and actionable decision-making for internal stakeholders.

YOUR FUTURE MISSION IN THE DFAR TEAM

Your Key Responsibilities Will Be


Finance Analysis and Business Support, including performing financial and accounting analysis and reconciliation activities;
Collaborate with business teams to translate functional requirements into scalable analytical solutions;
Develop interactive dashboards to monitor financial KPIs, data quality, and risk indicators, translating business requirements into visual and analytical reporting tools;
Analyze data transformation processes and measure quality through control frameworks, whilst proposing remediation plans using automation solutions and validation rules;
Participate in data quality governance initiatives, ensuring alignment with finance and accounting standards.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? HERE’S WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:


Degree in Data Science, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Actuarial Science, Data Engineering, or related fields;
4+ years of professional background in financial data analysis, including hands-on experience in finance/accounting environments, financial reporting activities and/or dashboard development;
Understanding of accounting principles, reconciliation processes and P&L/Balance Sheet concepts;
Strong technical skills, including experience with Power BI, Python and SQL (ideal)
Fluent in English. Fluency in French would be an additional advantage


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

In addition to our attractive salary, here’s a glimpse of what you can expect from us:


Generous Perks: Enjoy meal, child and monthly flexible benefits allowances as part of our comprehensive benefits package.
Comprehensive Coverage: Rest easy with our top-notch insurance package. You’ll have health insurance, applicable to your spouse and descendants as well as life insurance.
Flexibility Redefined: Embrace our hybrid working model for a perfect balance of commitment and personal flexibility.
Endless and tailored Professional Growth: Fuel your career aspirations with continuous development opportunities on both local and global scales
Vibrant Work Environment: Immerse yourself in our modern amenities, including zen rooms, free language courses, and diverse company events.
Culture of Care: Be part of a multicultural environment that prioritizes employee wellbeing and professional growth.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION ARE IMPORTANT TO US!

BNP Paribas Cardif is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Equity and diversity are at the core of our recruitment policy because we believe that they foster creativity and efficiency, which in turn increase performance and productivity. We strive to reflect on the society we live in, while keeping with the image of our clients.

CAN WE COUNT ON YOU?

If you're ready to shape the future of insurance and your profile aligns with our vision, send us your application with CV, cover letter, and Certificate of Studies. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

Note: Only complete applications with all the required documentation will be considered.

Title: Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis in Portugal is currently seeking a Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI to join its BPCE SI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques) team, within the IT (Information Technologies) department, to work in a hybrid work model in the Porto office, to join a data team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and our Data teams (Data Engineers, Data Analysts). To succeed in this mission, you will not just gather requirements: you will actively dive into the data by writing queries and analyzing our Oracle database tables to understand their structure, quality, and underlying logic.

Key Responsibilities


Write SQL queries to directly query and analyze tables within our database.
Explore and profile raw data to understand its structure, underlying business rules, and to identify potential anomalies.
Work closely with Data teams (Data Engineers, BI, and Analytics) to translate functional business rules into technical requirements.
Draft clear functional and technical specifications (source-to-target data mapping).
Assist business stakeholders in defining their requirements by providing a realistic view of the data actually available in the Oracle systems.
Design and execute test plans (both functional and technical data reconciliation).


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL (Essential): Strong ability to write complex queries (JOINs, subqueries, analytical functions, etc.) to query databases.
5+ years of solid experience as business analyst.
Oracle Environment: Proven experience working with Oracle databases (using tools such as PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver, or SQL Developer).
Data Analysis: Ability to analyze data models (tables, views, primary/foreign keys).
Data Modeling: Basic understanding of data architecture concepts (Data Warehouse, Data Marts).
French: Minimum C1 level (fluent/advanced) is required, as you will interact closely with French-speaking business stakeholders and write functional specifications in French. A good level of English is also required.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Title: Graduate Programme 2027: Data Scientist and Analyst
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Graduate Programme

Our Graduate Programme is built for ambitious graduates who want to launch their careers in fintech. Over this 12-month programme, you’ll work on real projects, solve complex challenges, and make an impact from day one. With structured training and hands-on experience, you’ll grow your skills while exploring different areas of the business.

Top performers can be promoted during or after the programme, giving you the chance to continue your journey at Revolut.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for Graduate Data Scientists and Analysts who are analytical, curious, and ready to deliver impact with data.

You’ll begin with an immersive boot camp designed to give you hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle. After that, you'll join a dedicated product team to specialise in your preferred data domain.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Graduate Programme is open to international applicants willing to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, Spain, the UK, or the UAE. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).

Key dates


Applications: open from May 2026
Recruitment process: July–December 2026
Programme start: early 2027 (January–June) or late 2027 (July–December)


Roles are filled on a rolling basis, so apply early. You can specify your preferred intake during the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing


Taking part in a hands-on bootcamp and working on real projects across multiple teams
Helping to build analytical tools and machine learning models (such as dashboards and ETLs) to support product launches
Improving visibility in user sign-up flows and operational funnels
Enhancing and maintaining data infrastructure (including ETLs and LookML) to keep data accessible and reliable
Collaborating with teams across Operations, Growth, and Product to refine features and uncover insights
Supporting decision-making with ad-hoc analysis (e.g., interest rate sensitivity, incentive profitability, conversion rates)
Learning from industry leaders and staying aligned with team priorities through weekly meetings
Managing tasks, tracking progress, and communicating key outcomes
Sharing updates with our global teams
Receiving regular feedback to guide your development


What You'll Need


A predicted or achieved 2:1 (or equivalent grade) in computer science, maths, physics, or a related field
To have graduated in 2025, 2026, or 2027
Impressive Python and SQL skills
A solid foundation in maths and statistics
An interest in analytics engineering, product analytics, data science, or ML engineering
Great problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset
Fluency in English and excellent communication skills
Full-time availability from early or late 2027
The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Title: HR Reporting and Analytics Manager
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



The HR Reporting and Analytics Manager is responsible for managing HR data and analytics to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.



Responsibilities



Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.
Lead and mentor HR Reporting and Analytics team, ensuring effective task assignment, skills development and alignment with team and business goals. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and professional growth within the team.



Education



Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.



Experience



Proven experience in HR reporting, data analytics, and data management within a corporate environment.
Strong knowledge of HR systems (such as SAP SuccessFactors), data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and data governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data, communicate insights effectively, and align reporting strategies with business objectives.
Excellent leadership and project management skills, with a focus on driving results and fostering a collaborative team environment.
